title: Software Engineer
description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

- Philipp Koellinger , CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
- Christian Roessler , co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
- Ogban Ugot , engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.
You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
- Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
- Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
- Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
- Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
- Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
- Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
- Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
- Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.
Required skills and experience

- Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
- Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
- Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
- Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
- Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
- Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
- Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
- An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
- The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
- Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.
Nice to have

- Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
- Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
- Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
- Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
- Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
- Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
- Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
- An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.
You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

- You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
- Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
- You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
- You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.
What we offer

- $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
- Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
- Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
- Travel and visa support for business needs.
- Flexible remote working.

Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply

Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits 

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

- Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

- Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

- Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

- Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

- Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

- You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

- You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

- You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

- You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

- You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: Scientific Account Executive
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

- Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

- Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

- Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

- Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

- Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities 

- Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

- Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

- Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

- Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

- Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

- Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

- Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

- Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for 

- Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

- Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

- Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

- Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

- Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

- Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â 

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today. 

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

The Role 

As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities: 

- Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders.

- National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint.

- Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth.

- Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams.

- Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct.

- Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance.

- Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings.

What You'll Need to Succeed 

- Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential.

- Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains.

- Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders.

- Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision.

- Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy.

AI in our hiring process 

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy 

Â 

Our Approach to AI 

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

title: Graduate Transport Planner
description:
At Curtins, we're an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone. 

For over 65 years, we've delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive. 

As a Graduate Transport Planner, you'll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career.

Whether you're interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we'll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning.

What you'll be doing 

You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. 

- Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. 

- Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. 

- Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. 

- Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. 

- Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. 

- Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. 

- Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. 

What kind of projects will I get to work on? 

You'll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: 

- Residential developments. 

- Urban regeneration schemes. 

- Commercial and industrial projects. 

- Education and healthcare developments. 

- Mixed-use masterplans. 

- Strategic land and development opportunities. 

You'll help assess how developments interact with the transport network and support clients through the planning process, helping turn ideas into deliverable projects. 

How will Curtins support my development? 

Our goal is simple: to help you become the best engineer you can be. 

Through the Curtins Graduate Academy, you'll follow a structured development programme designed to accelerate both your technical and professional growth. 

You'll benefit from: 

- A structured graduate development programme. 

- Dedicated mentoring and coaching. 

- Regular technical and professional skills training. 

- Support towards professional registration and Chartership. 

- Exposure to a wide range of projects, clients and sectors. 

- Opportunities to build your network across the business. 

You'll be supported by experienced professionals who are genuinely invested in your success and development. 

What we're looking for 

We're looking for graduates who are curious, analytical and interested in how development projects are planned and delivered. 

You'll ideally be studying towards or have recently completed a degree in: 

- Transport Planning 

- Geography 

- Urban Planning 

- Civil Engineering 

- Town Planning 

- Geography or a related discipline 

It would also be advantageous to hold an MSc in Transport Planning, Transport Engineering, Urban Planning, or Development Planning. 

Most importantly, we're looking for people who share our values: 

Integrity - Doing the right thing. 

Being Human - Supporting and respecting others. 

Curiosity - Asking questions and seeking better solutions. 

Impact - Making a meaningful difference through our work. 

Why join Curtins? 

As an employee-owned business, every person at Curtins contributes to and benefits from our success. 

Alongside exciting projects and a supportive culture, you'll enjoy: 

- Industry-leading benefits package. 

- Award-winning training and development programmes. 

- Employee ownership benefits. 

- Opportunities to get involved in STEM, charity and community initiatives. 

- Access to our unique Employee Extras, including our 5-star holiday lodges. 

Most importantly, you'll be joining a business where your ideas matter, your development is supported and your contribution makes a real difference. 

Build your future with Curtins. 

Should you wish to discuss any adjustments to the application process or provide us with feedback please contact hr@curtins.com we would be happy to discuss ways we can make the process more suitable to your needs.

We value diversity and respect all differences in people. We invite enthusiastic individuals who share in our values of teamwork, client focus, integrity, and quality to apply to join us.

title: Director of IT and Workplace
description:
The Role 

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment 

- Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

- Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

- Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

- Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

- Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do 

Strategy, budget, and team 

- Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

- Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

- Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

- Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure 

- Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

- Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

- Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

- Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

- Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk 

- Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

- Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

- Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

- Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

- Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities 

- Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

- Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

- Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

- Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

- Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring 

- 8+ years in IT , spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

- 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams , including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

- Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

- Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

- Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

- Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience , with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

- Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

- Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have 

- Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

- IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

- Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

- Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
description:
OUR MISSION 

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

- Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

- Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

- Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

- Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

- Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

- Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

- Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE 

- 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

- You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

- Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

- You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

- You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

- You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves: 

- Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

- Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES 

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose. 

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible. 

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

- Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

- Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

- Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

- Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

- Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

- Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

- Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

- Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

- Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications 

- 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

- Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

- 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

- Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

- Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

- Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

- Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

- Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

- Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

- Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

What We're Looking For

description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Innovate with Tether

But thatâs just the beginning: 

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. 

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. 

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself. 

Responsibilities 

- Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference. 

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. 

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. 

Mandatory: 

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source . 

Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: 

- Apply only through our official channels. Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/ 

- Verify the recruiterâs identity. Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. 

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. 

- Double-check email addresses. Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @ tether.to orÂ @ tether.io 

- We will never request payment or financial details. Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. 

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Director Payment Integrity
description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity 

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties: 

- Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management

- Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

- Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements

- Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

- Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA

- Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities

- Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights

- Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise

- Interact directly with customers as needed

- Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

- Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs

- Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement: 

- B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation

- 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment

- Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements

- Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred

- Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis

- Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights

- Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers

- Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items

- Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines

- Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system

- Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Retention & CLV Operator (all genders)
description:
Welcome to Glow25! 

At Glow25 , we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on.

We look forward to getting to know you.

These are our current challenges and future goals: 

Five years ago, Glow25 started from zero. Today we are one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands, with a large community of returning customers. Our biggest lever is making sure those customers stay with us: through a strong subscription programme, a loyalty programme and a lifecycle experience that gives them a reason to come back, again and again.

To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Retention & CLV Operator who works alongside our existing teams, keeps the big picture in view and sets up our retention engine structurally. Ownership covers Klaviyo flows, our subscription programme and our loyalty programme, plus post-purchase, replenishment, education, win-back and sales campaigns. Copy, flows and launches come from one person, with access to a rich customer data set and the freedom to build individual AI workflows. Lifecycle work that was written and built personally, and that moved repeat purchase or customer value, makes an application stand out.

This role joins an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving them together with the teams is encouraged.

This is where we need your support: 

- Retention strategy and customer journey: Strategic thinking that keeps the whole lifecycle in view and sets up retention structurally, from onboarding, product education and replenishment to cross-sell and win-back, so that customers stay with us long term and the setup scales across markets.

- Subscription and loyalty programmes: Experience building and growing a subscription offering and loyalty mechanics, from the sign-up experience and churn prevention to VIP experiences that turn customers into long-term fans.

- Lifecycle flows in Klaviyo: Hands-on expertise in building triggers, audiences, timing, branches and suppression rules independently in Klaviyo.

- Copy and campaigns: Direct-response copywriting and storytelling that moves customers, from campaign emails to long-form sales sequences, plus planning and running customer moments, product launches and seasonal sales together with Acquisition and Creative.

- Data and AI-driven decisions: Confidence in using cohort, repeat-purchase and contribution-margin evidence to choose tests and make clear decisions, paired with practical use of AI for customer research, copy exploration and workflows, with human judgment on claims and final copy.

- Localization and collaboration: A feel for adapting stories and offers to each market instead of translating them, while keeping one brand voice, and a collaborative way of working with Acquisition, Customer Service, Product and Analytics, sharing learnings so that all teams get faster.

You have the following experience: 

- Personally written and built lifecycle programs in D2C or e-commerce, ideally in a high-repeat category such as supplements, beauty or food, with clear proof of what was written, built, launched, measured and changed.

- Track record of subscription, loyalty, post-purchase, replenishment or win-back programs that moved repeat purchase, revenue per recipient or customer value.

- Strong direct-response instincts and storytelling skills across short and long formats, plus hands-on experience in a lifecycle platform, ideally Klaviyo.

- A structural, big-picture mindset and comfort with e-commerce economics and experiments: retention set up as a system rather than a series of one-off campaigns, with the ability to separate real lift from attributed revenue, without being a pure analyst.

- Hands-on use of AI in the last 12 months to speed up research, copy or workflows. Show us what you built.

- A collaborative communicator who brings colleagues along by explaining decisions clearly and sharing learnings, fluent in English; German or another European language is a plus.

That's something you can look forward to: 

- Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.

- Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.

- Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.

- Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.

- Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.

- Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

- Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

- Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.

- Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.

- Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

- Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.

- Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

Yay! You've made it this far! 

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager - Software (m/w/d)
description:
Du bist Hunter mit Strategie-Gen: Du jagst Wachstumschancen, denkst in Portfolios statt in Einzelprojekten und in Kundenbeziehungen statt in Einzelabschlüssen – und du machst andere erfolgreich? Dann gestalte mit uns, womit und wie die Coduct Solutions im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand wächst.

Coduct Group in 30 Sekunden 

Wir modernisieren IT für Unternehmen, die mit Software Geld verdienen oder ihre Prozesse digitalisieren: Cloud-Migration, Daten & KI, individuelle Software und Betrieb. Dazu gehören unser Marke CODE LEAP in Vietnam für das Software Engineering, unsere Marke ainavio mit einer SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement und unser Geschäft als Microsoft CSP-Partner. Wir sind dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner und arbeiten u. a. für JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria. 

Für die nächste Wachstumsphase haben wir die Funktion Growth gegründet. Ein VP Growth plant das Wachstum und befähigt Marketing und Vertrieb, es zu realisieren. Du wirst das erste Teammitglied an seiner Seite. 

Deine Mission 

Ein Portfolio und eine Roadmap bauen, mit denen Coduct nachhaltig wächst – und Marketing und Vertrieb so ausstatten, dass sie damit gewinnen. 

Drei Prinzipien, die du mit uns umsetzt 

Land & Expand 

- Kunden starten mit einem klaren, risikoarmen Einstiegsangebot – und wachsen über definierte Ausbaupfade in Projekte, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS. Aus Aufträgen werden langfristige Kundenbeziehungen. 

Balance Volumen & Premium 

- Standardisierte Volumenangebote sorgen für Skalierung und wiederkehrende Umsätze, individuelle Premiumleistungen für Differenzierung und Marge. Du gestaltest den Mix so, dass sich beide Welten verstärken. 

Hunting 

- Wachstum wartet nicht. Du spürst Chancen aktiv auf – Segmente, Partner, Großchancen – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in Umsatz und EBIT – und in deiner variablen Vergütung. 

Deine ersten 12 Monate 

Monat 1–3 

- Du lernst Portfolio, Kunden und Teams kennen, analysierst Portfolio-Mix, Bestandskunden und Pipeline und legst mit dem VP Growth die Growth-Roadmap und die Prioritäten fest. 

Monat 4–6 

- Die ersten zwei bis drei Einstiegsangebote mit Ausbaupfad sind marktreif. Der Vertrieb hat Playbook, Pitch und Pricing-Rechner, Marketing startet die ersten Kampagnen – auch für unsere CSP-Bestandskunden. 

Monat 7–12 

- Das Portfolio ist klar strukturiert in Volumen und Premium, das KPI-System zeigt Expansion, Mix und Marge, und Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery arbeiten mit gemeinsamen OKRs. Du übernimmst zunehmend bereichsübergreifende Growth-Themen. 

Was du konkret tust 

- Hunting: Du jagst Wachstumschancen und Großchancen und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss 

- Roadmap: Du entwickelst die Growth-Roadmap, bewertest Segmente, Partnerschaften und neue Geschäftsfelder und machst daraus priorisierte Initiativen 

- Portfolio: Du produktisierst Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten, schärfst unsere Premiumleistungen und verantwortest Positionierung, Pricing und Lifecycle 

- Land & Expand: Du baust Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade – und Programme, mit denen der Vertrieb Bestandskunden weiterentwickelt 

- Enablement: Du gibst Vertrieb und Marketing Playbooks, Messaging, Kampagnen, Schulungen und Tools an die Hand 

- Steuerung: Du gestaltest Prozesse und Schnittstellen und baust ein KPI-System für Funnel, Expansion, Portfolio-Mix und Marge 

- Verbinden: Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery in Deutschland und Vietnam 

Das bringst du mit 

Das brauchen wir 

- 5+ Jahre B2B-Erfahrung in Portfolio-/Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development 

- Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert und bepreist 

- Erfahrung mit Land-and-Expand-Modellen und Bestandsentwicklung 

- Verständnis für Standard- und Premiumgeschäft 

- Eigene Vertriebspraxis und Gespür für den Mittelstand 

- Kenntnis von SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Modellen und dem DACH-Markt 

- Prozess- und Zahlenverständnis: Prozesse, CRM, KPIs 

- Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch

Das macht dich besonders 

- Erfahrung mit Sales Enablement oder Revenue Operations 

- Ein Netzwerk im Mittelstand oder in der Microsoft-Partnerwelt 

- Routinierter Einsatz von KI-Tools 

- Erfahrung mit verteilten, internationalen Teams 

- Erste Erfolge beim Aufbau einer Growth- oder Portfolio-Funktion 

Du passt zu uns, wenn … 

- du als Hunter neue Wachstumschancen jagst – und sie mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss bringst 

- du dich gern an Ergebnissen messen lässt – an KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT 

- du lieber machst als ankündigst und Ideen schnell im Markt testest 

- du Vertrieb und Marketing ohne Weisungsbefugnis für neue Wege gewinnst 

- du gern im Team arbeitest – auch verteilt, remote und über Zeitzonen hinweg 

- du wachsen willst: fachlich, in der Verantwortung und mit dem Unternehmen 

Eher nicht, wenn … 

- du eigene Kunden betreuen und Abschlüsse allein verbuchen willst, statt Wachstum gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu realisieren 

- du dich lieber nicht an messbaren Ergebnissen orientierst 

- du Strategie lieber präsentierst, als sie umzusetzen 

Das bekommst du 

- Echten Einfluss: Du baust eine neue Unternehmensfunktion mit auf – mit kurzen Wegen zu VP Growth und Geschäftsführung 

- Leistung, die sich lohnt: Fixgehalt plus variable Vergütung nach Zielerreichung deiner Growth-KPIs und deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT 

- Eine klare Perspektive in Richtung leitender Growth-Rolle 

- Cloud-, KI- und SaaS-Themen mit eigenem Delivery-Center 

- Ein Team, das ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt 

- Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region

So geht's weiter 

- Lebenslauf schicken und kurz beantworten: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat? 

- Erstgespräch per Video mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing (ca. 75 Minuten) 

- Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung: Du zeigst uns, wie du Wachstum gestalten würdest (ca. 90 Minuten) 

- Angebot – in der Regel innerhalb von vier Wochen nach dem Erstgespräch 

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

Land & Expand

Monat 1–3

Monat 4–6

Das bringst du mit 

Das brauchen wir

Das macht dich besonders

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

- du gern im Team arbeitest – auch verteilt, remote und über Zeitzonen hinweg

Eher nicht, wenn …

- du dich lieber nicht an messbaren Ergebnissen orientierst

Das bekommst du

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do: 

- Prospect into large Fortune 1000 companies while running an efficient sales process

- Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts

- Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business

- Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI

- Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory

- Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution

- Have intuitive sense of necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation

- Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities

- Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

Who You Are: 

- Someone with 5+ years closing experience (mix of field selling within mid-market and enterprise)

- Driven and have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $100k+

- Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own

- Experienced in working for an innovative tech company (SaaS, IT infrastructure or similar preferred)

- Experienced in selling into large Fortune 1000 companies with the ability to win new logos

- Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

Benefits and Growth: 

- High income earning opportunities based on self performance

- New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

- Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 

- Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 

- Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 

- An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds

- Generous and competitive medical benefits package

- Retirement savings match

- Pet adoption and insurance program

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Business Development Manager
description:

We transform heavy machinery—bulldozers, loaders, excavators—into AI-powered fleets that operate continuously, safely, and at peak performance in the world’s harshest environments.

AIM runs production mines, large scale infrastructure builds, and defense operations as a TRL9 hardened system, not a science experiment.

Built by engineers from mining, construction, Waymo, SpaceX, Google and Tesla, AIM enables scalable earthmoving, turbocharging the global economy’s physical foundation. About The Role 

As part of the business development backbone of the company, you will lead AIM’s commercials across multiple layers of the business.

AIM Sales Managers bring both front-line selling ability and operational discipline. They close deals, build pipelines, and implement the systems with the sole focus on customer success.

You will sit at the intersection of sales execution, partnerships, and strategy. You will not only drive revenue yourself but also help grow a high-performing sales organization.

If you want to remove any ceiling above you and stretch your ambition, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own 

1. Revenue Generation

2. Partnerships & Channel Growth
