Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.

About the Role 

We are seeking an exceptional People leader to guide our global talent and organizational strategy through the next phase of growth and beyond. Swap is currently 350 FTEs spread across 9 countries, and has a number of critical hires in the near term. This is a crucial executive role for a People leader who is a proven talent magnet, a strategic operator, and heavily data-driven.

The role demands global compliance expertise, systems thinking, a relentless focus on the employee experience and time-to-productivity, and a deep understanding of how to scale culture across borders without losing operational velocity. You will build and lead Swap's People function, shifting the organization from foundational HR to a strategic engine that drives tangible business outcomes and maximizes revenue per employee. This role is designed for a highly ambitious people leader who is excited about the opportunity to play a critical role in scaling Swap through to a potential future IPO.

What You'll Do 

- Leadership — Build and develop a world-class, high-performing People & Talent team, nurturing a team culture focused on business outcomes, operational excellence, and exceptional candidate and employee experience.

- Talent & performance — Build the systems that keep the talent bar high across the company, from hiring and onboarding through to performance management and manager effectiveness. Enable Swap's leaders to drive hiring in a hyper-growth environment, and ensure managers have the tools and support to lead their teams well.

- Culture — Strengthen and evolve Swap's culture as the company scales, ensuring Swap's values translate consistently regardless of the function, role or geography.

- Compensation & reward — Design and own a clear, competitive, and scalable compensation strategy that supports global hiring while remaining fair and defensible across markets.

- Org design & compliance — Own and execute Swap's global talent strategy, architecting an organisational design that supports rapid scaling across 8+ countries while mitigating geographical fragmentation. Navigate the complexity of EORs, local entities, and cross-border compliance, building cohesive global frameworks rather than one-off local fixes.

- Business impact & metrics — Ensure the People organisation is a core driver of business success, developing a clear people strategy and roadmap aligned to the business strategy. Define clear Swap People metrics and track progress against these such as Time to Hire, eNPS, and turnover. Own the People function's success measures and deliver results against targets set.

- Cross-functional alignment — Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across Swap's leadership team and beyond, aligning People strategy, headcount planning, and org design with the pace and needs of the business.

What We're Looking For 

- A builder at heart, energised by the opportunity to shape an emerging category at pace, and comfortable with the ambiguity of a fast-scaling startup.

- A proven track record of building and leading high-performing People leadership teams, with the credibility to attract and develop leaders of leaders.

- 12-15+ years of progressive People/HR leadership experience, with direct exposure to scaling hyper-growth tech organizations from 200 to 500+ employees globally.

- A mindset that balances people and business outcomes, using employee-centric thinking to build simple, scalable solutions to complex global compliance and talent challenges.

- Skilled at using modern HR tech, AI, and automation to drive efficiency and streamline all aspects of the talent lifecycle at scale.

- Experience leading teams across multiple international markets, dealing with complex cross-border employment laws and asynchronous work cultures.

What we offer 

💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us.

📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows.

🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly.

🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly.

🏦 Pension contributions: Company contributions to help you build long-term financial security.

🧘 Wellness benefits: Support for your physical health and wellbeing, so you can look after yourself in the way that works for you.

💚 Mental health support: Access to mental health resources and support, because looking after your mind matters as much as your body.

👶 Enhanced maternity and paternity leave: Extra support when you’re growing your family, so you can focus on what matters most.

🏡 Flexible working: Choose how and where you do your best work, with the trust and autonomy to manage your own time.

title: Senior Engineer, High Performance Data Systems
description:

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

The role 

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

The timing is rare. A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 150 and still accelerating, driven by massive demand. We are building the team to unlock our next orders of magnitude of scale and capability.

What you'll do 

- Own significant projects in our data systems end to end: design, architecture, deployment, monitoring and measuring the impact you made

- Build distributed systems that stay fast and correct under load, and reason carefully about every way they can fail

- Shape performant protocols and APIs, that customers build directly on top of

- Find simple solutions to complex domains at scale, and know when boring technology wins

- Raise the bar for everyone around you through code reviews, pairing and sharing what you know

Why engineers join Foundations 

- Scale that's genuinely hard. Multimodal AI data is big, messy and growing fast. You'll solve problems most backend engineers only read about.

- Real ownership. You'll own whole systems, not tickets, and the architectural calls are yours to make.

- Work that ships. Your systems power 300+ AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

- Long-term thinking. A team that plans 24 months out and gives you room to build things properly.

- The right moment. A Series C company growing fast, early enough that your decisions shape the platform for years.

Who we're looking for 

- You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

- You combine rigorous engineering with ruthless prioritisation to ship efficient and correct systems quickly.

- You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

- You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements 

- Fluency in at least one high level (Python, Typescript), and one imperative statically typed (Rust, C++, Java, Go, or other)

- Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching, consistency) and how they behave under load

- Deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures and algorithms

- Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

Why Encord 

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

- Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

- Daily team lunches & dinners

- Annual learning & development budget

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

- US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

- UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

- Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

- Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials 

Operating principles 

High agency 

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency 

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry 

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time 

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About the Team 

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Role Overview 

As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.

This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.

On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.

Responsibilities 

- Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.

- Define and evolve the architecture of highly available cloud-native infrastructure, balancing performance, reliability, security and cost as the platform grows.

- Set technical direction for CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, remaining hands-on in delivering improvements to the software delivery lifecycle.

- Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.

- Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.

- Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.

- Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.

- Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.

- Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.

- Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.

title: Principal Compliance Officer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PRINCIPAL COMPLIANCE OFFICER 

The UK financial crime program is being built now, and it has to stand up to the FCA. This role sits in Compliance, reports to the US BSA/AML Officer, and owns the UK framework end to end — AML/CTF, sanctions, fraud, ABC, KYC/CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, SARs, and the operating rhythm. You will still work the hard cases. It is a builder seat with accountability, not a queue job with “strategy” in the title.

If you have eight or more years inside an FCA-regulated bank, EMI, PI, or payments firm, have owned or rebuilt a financial crime control framework, and can still open a file, this is the seat. You will build the UK program from the ground up, setting the standards the team and the FCA will use. This is consumer-scale payments financial crime work – not a private-banking book – and you’ll sit directly with Product and Engineering. You’ll operate in a small team with a direct line to the US BSA/AML Officer, where scope is broad and process is lean. The measure of success is a program that still works a year later, and the role sits alongside MLRO / SMF17-adjacent duties for the UK entity.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Design and run the UK financial crime programme: policy, procedures, CDD/EDD, risk rating, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, SAR handling, escalation, QA, and training

- Turn MLR 2017, POCA, the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act, JMLSG, the FCA Financial Crime Guide, SYSC 6.3, and payments/EMI expectations into something operations and product can run

- Own the UK business-wide risk assessment and keep it honest as the product, customer mix, and channels change

- Handle complex cases — PEPs, adverse media, sanctions hits, high-risk onboarding, fraud typologies, escalations — then use the queue to fix the framework

- Stand up first- and second-line controls: documentation, workflows, vendor oversight, quality sampling, MI, and issue management

- Put UK requirements into the customer journey with Legal, Operations, Product, and Engineering. Be the UK voice in global design decisions

- Report on quality, residual risk, throughput, and control health, and prepare the program for internal audit, skilled-person reviews, and FCA scrutiny

- Build the operating model as the team grows.

- Hire, coach, and set the standard

- Support MLRO / SMF17-adjacent duties as the UK permissions model requires

BASiC QUALIFICATIONS: 

- 8+ years of hands-on experience with financial crime in a regulated UK firm (bank, EMI, PI, payments, or e-money), including substantial KYC/CDD/EDD

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

- You will still do the cases, close gaps in a small team, do not wait for a 30-page RACI

- You know the UK regime well enough to argue a point — MLR 2017, JMLSG, POCA, UK sanctions, FCA expectations — and how it lands in a payments product

- You have designed or rebuilt a framework, procedure, or control, not only cleared files or written a policy nobody ran

- You have led people or a workstream. You can defend a risk decision and explain it to the Product without jargon

- Experience with the EU AML package, 6AMLD, EBA guidelines, national transposition, or an EU FIU/regulator, especially on cross-border payments, wallets, or EMI/PI products (useful because X Money will not stay inside one perimeter)

title: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA
description:
Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA 

The Role 

Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders.

This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be.

About Us 

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do 

- Lead Lyrebird’s clinical safety management system for the UK and Ireland, ensuring DCB0129 compliance, supporting customers with DCB0160, and providing senior oversight of our Clinical Safety Officers.

- Bring the clinical voice into the product roadmap, defining UK- and Ireland-specific workflows and leading clinical validation of new models, features and specialty templates before release.

- Own clinical incident management and chair our clinical governance and safety committee, reporting to the leadership team and board.

- Advise on the regulatory landscape, including MHRA medical device regulation, NHS England guidance on ambient voice technology, DTAC, and the EU AI Act for Ireland.

- Design and deliver a clinical evidence strategy, running evaluations and real-world studies with NHS and academic partners, publishing the results, and always reporting limitations honestly.

- Act as a trusted clinical peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and digital leaders across NHS trusts, ICBs and the HSE, and represent Lyrebird at conferences, in the media and in national policy conversations.

- Bring clinical credibility to the commercial team by leading the clinical, safety and evidence sections of tenders, supporting pilots, and making sure every clinical claim we make stands up.

- Build and lead a UK and Ireland clinical team, and champion equity, patient safety and inclusive design across languages, accents and patient groups.

What you’ll bring 

- Full GMC registration with a licence to practise, in good standing.

- Significant senior clinical leadership experience in the NHS, such as Medical Director, Deputy or Associate Medical Director, or Clinical Director.

- Substantial digital health or clinical informatics leadership, for example as a CCIO, CMIO or senior clinical lead on an EPR or digital transformation programme.

- In-depth, practical knowledge of DCB0129 and DCB0160, clinical risk management, hazard logs and safety cases, plus a solid grasp of MHRA, DTAC, DSPT and NHS England AI guidance.

- A track record of designing, leading or publishing clinical evaluations, audits or research.

- Strong NHS networks and the ability to explain complex clinical, technical and regulatory issues clearly to boards, clinicians, engineers and patients.

Nice to have 

- Accredited Clinical Safety Officer training, and continuing clinical practice alongside the role.

- Experience in a health tech, MedTech or digital health company, ideally including evaluation of AI or NLP safety and performance.

- Knowledge of the EU AI Act, EU MDR and the Irish health system, or registration with the Medical Council of Ireland.

- Membership or fellowship of the Faculty of Clinical Informatics, or a national profile through the Royal Colleges, NHS England or a Health Innovation Network.

- Familiarity with clinical coding (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, OPCS-4), PRSB standards or the NICE Evidence Standards Framework.

Every minute a clinician spends on documentation is a minute taken from their patients. In this role, you’ll help decide how ambient AI is safely adopted across the NHS and in Ireland, setting the standards that protect patients while giving clinicians time back to focus on care.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

description:
About us 

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

- French and USA payroll and entity obligations

- European employees through an EOR setup

- Growing Paris and New York offices

- Multiple benefits providers and external partners

- An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees .

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

- Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

- Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

- Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

- Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

- Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

- Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

- Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

- Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

- Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

- Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

- Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

- Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

- Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

- Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

- Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

- Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

- HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

- Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

- Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

- Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

- Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

- Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

- A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

- Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

- High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

- Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

- Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

- Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it. 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) .

SEO Strategy & Optimization

- Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
- Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation 

- Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads .

Content Marketing & Website Management 

- Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.

- Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms .
- Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.
Analytics, Reporting & Optimization 

- Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager .
- Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
- Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
- Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
Marketing Automation & CRM 

- Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
- Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign .
- Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
- Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.
Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
- Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
- Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization .
- Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools .
- Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns .
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
- Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
- Availability during U.S. Business Hours .
Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) .
- Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
- Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

Success in this role will be measured through:

title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission 

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse. 

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités 

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités : 

- 
Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

- 
Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

- 
Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

- 
Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

- 
Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

- 
Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

- 
Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

- 
Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- 
Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

- 
Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

- 
Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

- 
Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

- 
Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

- 
Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- 
Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

- 
Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

- 
Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

- 
FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

- 
Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

- 
Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- 
Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- 
Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- 
Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- 
Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- 
Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- 
Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
description:
Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. 

L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.
Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. 

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission 

En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

Activités & Responsabilités 

- Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA 

Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.

- Analyses, business cases & prototypage 

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

- Delivery, livrables & collaboration 

Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous produisez des sections de livrables de niveau C-suite, rédigez les storylines du stream, participez aux synthèses exécutives sur votre périmètre et construisez un narratif qui appuie la recommandation et emporte l’adhésion. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

- Relation client & développement commercial 

Vous construisez une relation de proximité avec votre interlocuteur direct, élargissez le réseau de parties prenantes aux équipes opérationnelles et au middle management, anticipez les résistances et animez des ateliers en autonomie. Vous identifiez des opportunités, soutenez le plan de compte avec le Manager et le Directeur et participez aux propositions et aux événements de networking.

- Équipe & connaissances 

Vous déléguez avec des instructions claires, donnez des feedbacks constructifs, animez des 1to1 avec les consultants juniors et participez aux rétrospectives et aux entretiens de candidats. Vous contribuez à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des sessions d’onboarding et des formations internes.

Profil recherché 

Vous vous reconnaissez si … vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.

- 2 à 5 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.

title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission 

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse. 

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités 

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités : 

- 
Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

- 
Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

- 
Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

- 
Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

- 
Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

- 
Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

- 
Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

- 
Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- 
Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

- 
Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

- 
Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

- 
Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

- 
Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

- 
Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- 
Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

- 
Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

- 
Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

- 
FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

- 
Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

- 
Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- 
Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- 
Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- 
Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- 
Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- 
Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- 
Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
description:
Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. 

L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.
Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. 

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission 

En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

Activités & Responsabilités 

- Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA 

Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.

- Analyses, business cases & prototypage 

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

- Delivery, livrables & collaboration 

Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous produisez des sections de livrables de niveau C-suite, rédigez les storylines du stream, participez aux synthèses exécutives sur votre périmètre et construisez un narratif qui appuie la recommandation et emporte l’adhésion. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

- Relation client & développement commercial 

Vous construisez une relation de proximité avec votre interlocuteur direct, élargissez le réseau de parties prenantes aux équipes opérationnelles et au middle management, anticipez les résistances et animez des ateliers en autonomie. Vous identifiez des opportunités, soutenez le plan de compte avec le Manager et le Directeur et participez aux propositions et aux événements de networking.

- Équipe & connaissances 

Vous déléguez avec des instructions claires, donnez des feedbacks constructifs, animez des 1to1 avec les consultants juniors et participez aux rétrospectives et aux entretiens de candidats. Vous contribuez à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des sessions d’onboarding et des formations internes.

title: Technical Marketing Manager
description:
As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams, as well as memory design and strategic partnership teams, you gather validated information to create key materials, including product and specification documents in line with system architects and product managers, datasheets, reference manuals, whitepapers, application notes, technical blogs, and technical presentation decks. 

In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences. 

Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market. 

Technical writing/content development | primary focus 

- Write technical documentation (product, specifications..), customer-facing datasheets, reference manuals. 

- Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content. 

- Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering. 

- Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations. 

- Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders. 

- Create and coordinate high-quality technical content: website copy, product pages, whitepapers, presentations, and conference materials 

Interface with Product, Architecture & Engineering 

- Work closely with the Product/Architecture team and relevant engineering experts to gather information about functionality, use cases, performance, power, bandwidth, integration and system-level trade-offs. 

- Ask probing technical questions, distinguish demonstrated results from targets, and turn source material into precise, readable drafts. 

- Coordinate technical review and approval with the relevant subject-matter owners and marketing lead before external release; maintain the traceability and versioning of technical claims. 

Technical marketing & enablement 

- Participate in first-level customer technical meetings to present and support technical specifications, architecture choices, and performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs to system architects. 

- Support early customer engagements with tailored messaging and technical storytelling 

- Produce technically sound product and competitive comparisons that support the positioning and priorities defined by the Marketing Lead. 

- Develop technical content for product pages, demonstrations, customer briefings, partner presentations and Business Development enablement. 

- Support agreed conference submissions and product milestones with the technical material needed by speakers and customer-facing teams. 

- Support presence at industry events, conferences, and partner demos 

Content execution & quality 

- Own timelines, drafts, review loops, version control and delivery for assigned content; flag missing inputs and risks early. 

- Maintain a curated, approved repository of technical facts, diagrams, reusable explanations and reference materials. 

- Demonstrate adaptability to a fast-moving startup environment and evolving targets. 

Training background : Degree in electronics, microelectronics, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience is also welcome. 

Relevant experience: Practical experience in technical writing, technical marketing, applications engineering, product engineering, or another engineering-facing communication role. Suitable seniority may range from an emerging independent contributor to an experienced specialist. 

Technical / industry knowledge: Solid understanding of semiconductor hardware and system concepts; familiarity with memory architectures, SoCs, AI accelerators, advanced packaging or compute infrastructure is strongly valued. Ability to understand performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs and data from technical experts is essential. 

Writing / communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate effectively in meetings, structure detailed technical arguments, edit precisely, and tailor content to technical audiences. Evidence of authored documentation or published technical content is a strong plus.

Design & Visual Content Independence: Must be capable of creating compelling technical content, diagrams, and visual assets independently (e.g. Powerpoint, Google slides, Canva, Gimp..) without relying on external agencies, and should be well-versed with office productivity tools and presentation software. 

Interpersonal skills and ways of working: Curious, rigorous, comfortable challenging ambiguous input; proactive in working with engineers; strong prioritization, commitment to deadlines and careful technical-review discipline. 

Other considerations: Portfolio or writing samples preferred. You should be able to write strong first drafts independently, while keeping in mind that final product definitions and external claims are handled by the product and marketing leads. 

Generative AI Tools: Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflows to enhance content creation productivity and efficiency.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
description:
About Actian 

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position. 

What You Will Own: 

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture 

- Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.

- Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.

- Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.

- Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment 

- Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.

- Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.

- Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.

- Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.

- Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations 

- Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.

- Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.

- Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.

- Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.

- Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.

- Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability 

- Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

- Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.

- Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.

- Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. Team Building & Leadership 

- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

- Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.

- Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.

- Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months: 

- Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.

- Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.

- Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.

- Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.

- Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.

- Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.

- Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

What You Bring: 

Leadership & Experience 

- 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.

- At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.

- Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.

- Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.

- A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.

- The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

Technical Expertise 

- Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.

- Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.

- Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.

- Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.

- Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.

- Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.

- Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.

- Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

AI-First Mindset 

- Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.

- Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.

- Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.

- A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

Leadership Approach 

- Strong ownership and execution skills.

- Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.

- Able to build teams and systems from scratch.

- Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.

- Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.

- Production experience across multiple cloud providers.

- Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.

- Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.

- OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.

- Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

How You Will Work: 
You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity. 

If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.

What We Offer: 

- The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.

- Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).

- Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team. 

Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us. 

We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do 

Program Planning & Execution 

- Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
- Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
- Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
- Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.
PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes 

- Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
- Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
- Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
- Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.
Risk, Issue & Performance Management 

- Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
- Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
- Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
- Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.
AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement 

- Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
- Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
- Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration 

- Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
- Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
- Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
- Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.
Requirements 

What You'll Need 

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

- Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

- A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

- Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.
