title: Control & Estimation Intern
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission 

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities 

- Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

- Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

- Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

- Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

- Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

- Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements 

- Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

- Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

- Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)

Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for

- PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.

- Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)

- Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg

- Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)

- Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

- Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.

- Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.

- Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.

- Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).

- Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.

- Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.

- Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.

- Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.

- Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.

Key Projects (2027 portfolio)

- Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.

- BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.

- Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.

- Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.

- Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.

- ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.

- Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).

Core Competencies

- Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.

- Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.

- Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.

- Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.

- Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.

- Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.

- Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.

- Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.

- Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.

- Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.

- Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.

- Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.

Strongly preferred

- Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.

- Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.

- Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).

- Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.

- Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.

- Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous

Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.

Reporting Line: Reporting to Head of IT Direct reports: none (functional lead of external infrastructure and security providers)

Workload: 100% - Hybrid

Travel: approx. 10% – PHENOGY offices, BESS customer sites and partner/supplier sites as required

We offer you: 

- Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership. 

- Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.

title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
The role 

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission 

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do 

Drive technical co-builds with partners 

- Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

- Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

- Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

- Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

- Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

- Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content 

- Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

- Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

- Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

- Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

- Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience 

- Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

- Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

- Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

- Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

- Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for 

- A strong engineering background

- The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

- Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

- Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

- A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

- Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

- Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

- The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if 

- You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

- You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

- You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

- You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

- You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if 

- Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

- You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

- You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

- You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing 

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like 

Within the first year, you will have:

- Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

- Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

- Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

- Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

- Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Credit and Financial Risk Manager
description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

What you can expect: 

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Risk team as a Credit and Financial Risk Manager?

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, you will lead independent second-line oversight of ClearBank's lending and financial risk activities. As a senior risk leader and recognised subject-matter expert, you will translate Risk strategy into business-critical delivery, shape appetite, policy, controls and governance, and influence material decisions across ClearBank Europe and the wider Group. You will provide authoritative challenge, anticipate emerging issues, lead complex remediation and recovery activity, and strengthen organisational capability while enabling sustainable growth.

Your role includes: 

- Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge across the design, approval, launch and ongoing management of lending products, ensuring material risks are understood, controlled and aligned with approved appetite.

- Own the second-line review and challenge of complex or material credit proposals, portfolio strategies and periodic reviews, providing clear recommendations to senior decision-makers and governance committees.

- Set the second-line approach to non-performing and vulnerable exposures, leading complex recovery strategies, senior stakeholder engagement, escalation and resolution to minimise losses and protect ClearBank's interests.

- Shape and maintain the policy, appetite, control and governance framework across the credit lifecycle, partnering with model validation and other specialists to ensure credit risk and provisioning models remain robust and fit for purpose.

- Provide senior oversight of financial risks, including asset and liability, liquidity and interest-rate risk, connecting risk assessments across disciplines and anticipating emerging balance-sheet vulnerabilities.

- Lead complex, cross-functional risk initiatives with potential enterprise application, translating strategy and regulatory expectations into practical improvements across ClearBank Europe and the wider ClearBank Group.

What does success in this role look like: 

You will:

- Maintain a high-quality lending portfolio that enables sustainable growth within risk appetite.

- Deliver forward-looking credit and financial risk insight that improves senior and committee decisions.

- Resolve complex and emerging risks issues, including non-performing exposures, through decisive intervention, recovery and escalation.

- Shape scalable policies, appetite, controls and governance for growth and regulatory change.

- Act as a recognised expert and trusted adviser, influencing senior stakeholders through expertise, sound judgement and constructive challenge.

- Align functions on competing priorities, ownership and enterprise risk outcomes.

- Build capability through coaching, delegation and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll bring: 

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

- Extensive experience leading second-line challenge of complex credit risk in regulated financial services.

- A track record of launching and scaling credit products within robust risk governance.

- Advanced expertise in institutional lending, portfolios, problem exposures and risk drivers.

- Strong knowledge of liquidity, interest-rate and asset-and-liability risk.

- Ability to lead complex work independently and improve risk outcomes.

- Exceptional analytical and communication skills, with credibility among senior stakeholders and committees.

- Leadership experience in coaching, setting standards and creating accountability.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you? 

- You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank.

- You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care.

- You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate.

- ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return: 

- We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance. 

- Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

- Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays.

- Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

- Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the Netherlands for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

- Socials – Regular social events open to all.

- Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

- Wellbeing – long term disability cover and accident cover.

- Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

- Pension – We offer generous pension contribution without mandatory employee contribution.

- Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement.

- Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

- Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

Role level: 5 

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

- 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

- Our enhanced family leave policies

- Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

- Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect: 

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. 

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. 

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. 

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. 

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! 

Equal Opportunities 

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit 

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

title: Senior Account Manager - Warehouse Automation - BENELUX
description:
At Exotec, we design elegant, plug-and-play, and reliable end-to-end warehouse robotics solutions. As a leading Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Integrator, we support some of the world’s most iconic brands in their transition to automation. We’re proud to design technology that doesn’t just redefine intralogistics; it also makes warehouses safer, faster, more efficient, and less physically demanding for the people working inside them.

Why this role matters

Ready to move the world of intralogistics with tech? Join us as a Service Account Manager. 

What You'll Do 

We are looking for individuals who put customers first, take ownership of their work, execute with rigor, and simplify complex challenges. Successful team members demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset, collaborate effectively across functions, and contribute to collective success. At Exotec, we value people who are proactive, transparent, respectful, adaptable, and committed to delivering excellence while building long-term trust with both customers and colleagues.

- Own the strategic relationship with a portfolio of customers, serving as their primary point of contact for service performance, escalations, and long-term success.
- Lead regular business reviews and governance meetings with customers, ensuring transparency on KPIs, system performance, ongoing actions, and improvement plans.
- Partner closely with Area Managers, Maintenance teams, Product, Performance Engineering, and Support functions to resolve customer concerns and drive operational excellence.
- Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating customer feedback and business needs into actionable improvement initiatives.
- Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities within customer accounts, coordinating proactive action plans to maintain customer satisfaction and contract performance.
- Support customer growth by identifying upselling opportunities, service extensions, and additional value-added solutions aligned with customer needs.
- Oversee the successful transition of customer sites from Deployment to Maintenance, ensuring a seamless handover and clear ownership model.
- Monitor contractual performance, service levels, and commercial commitments while ensuring alignment between customer expectations and operational delivery.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance system reliability, service quality, and the overall customer experience.
- Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, from operational teams to senior leadership, acting as a long-term partner to their business.

Requirements 

- Experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Service Delivery.
- Strong customer-facing skills and experience managing demanding stakeholders.
- Ability to navigate complex organizations and coordinate cross-functional teams.
- Commercial awareness with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
- Experience working in logistics, warehouse automation, intralogistics, manufacturing, industrial services, or a similar environment is highly valued.
- Excellent communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus.

Why you’ll love working here 

- Make an impact by building technology that improves business performance and people's everyday work. 
- Grow faster by solving complex challenges in a fast-moving company where innovation, speed and ambition accelerate your development. 
- Belong to a global team where diversity, inclusion and collaboration drive better decisions and stronger solutions. 
- Connect beyond work by sharing passions, celebrating milestones and building lasting relationships that strengthen the way we work together.

title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview: 

The Director, Global Operations Excellence will be responsible for leading Operational Excellence, standardisation, transformation, and continuous improvement across the Sony Interactive Entertainment global supply chain.

Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, this senior leader will oversee a team of Lean experts and Operational Excellence business standardisation specialists, ensuring SIE Operations continues to improve service quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and deliver consistent, high-performing operational practices across all regions.

Reporting into Global Operations, this role will act as a key transformation leader across the Operations division, partnering with Logistics, Warehousing, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, D2C, Customer Service, and regional Operations teams to drive measurable improvements across cost, service, process maturity, and customer experience.

What you’ll be doing: 

- Lead the global Operations Excellence agenda for SIE, defining and executing a transformation roadmap focused on standardisation, Lean capability, service partner development, and continuous improvement.

- Oversee the Operations Lean Kaizen Office, driving Lean transformation activities across operational functions, including Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba practices, waste reduction, cost improvement, and operational performance improvement.

- Lead the development of global operational standards, ensuring SIE delivers a consistent, high-quality service experience to customers, retailers, commercial partners, and internal stakeholders across all markets.

- Act as the central point for translating commercial, customer, and business requirements into operational solutions, ensuring requests are clearly assessed, prioritized, and converted into realistic delivery plans.

- Lead global service partner development, including strategic tender activity, performance improvement, and commercial governance across warehousing 3PLs, control tower 4PLs, transportation partners, and other key Operations service providers.

- Oversee centralised budgetary analysis across Operations, supporting visibility, control, and governance of OPEX and CAPEX activities across the global supply chain.

- Generate data-driven insights into operational performance, ways of working, service quality, cost drivers, and customer impact, using these insights to shape strategic and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key areas of focus: 

Service Partner Development

- Lead global Operations tender activity across key warehousing 3PL, control tower 4PL, transportation, and logistics service partners.

- Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and regional Operations teams to ensure tender processes are commercially robust and operationally aligned.

- Support service partner strategy, performance management, governance, and continuous improvement.

- Provide budgetary oversight and centralised analysis of OPEX and CAPEX spend across Operations.

- Identify opportunities to improve partner performance, cost efficiency, service delivery, and operational scalability.

Lean Transformation: Operations Lean Kaizen Office

- Lead the Operations Lean Kaizen Office as the centre of excellence for Lean transformation across SIE Operations.

- Drive Lean continuous improvement activities across all operational areas.

- Support weekly and monthly S&OE practices, ensuring continuous improvement is embedded into operational routines and decision-making.

- Lead and support Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba walks, process diagnostics, and waste reduction initiatives.

- Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, service quality, process flow, and operational performance.

- Build Lean capability across teams through coaching, standards, tools, and practical application.

Distribution Excellence

- Oversee global operational standardisation across distribution, warehousing, transportation, and fulfilment practices.

- Ensure SIE delivers one consistent, high level of operational service excellence to its global customer base.

- Develop data-driven insights into how operational practices impact customers, commercial outcomes, cost, and service performance.

- Act as the central funnel point for commercial and customer requests, translating business needs into operational realities.

- Identify global best practices and scale them across regions, partners, and operational functions.

- Establish performance metrics, governance forums, and improvement roadmaps to drive accountability and progress.

What we’re looking for: 

- 15+ years’ experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Operational Excellence, Lean Transformation, or a related global leadership role.

- Proven experience leading Operational Excellence, Lean, continuous improvement, or business transformation programs.

- Strong understanding of global supply chain operations, including warehousing, transportation, distribution, 3PL/4PL management, and operational governance.

- Experience leading or supporting global tenders, service partner development, and supplier performance improvement.

- Strong financial acumen, with experience overseeing or analyzing OPEX, CAPEX, cost performance, and budgetary controls.

- Demonstrated experience with Lean tools and methodologies, including Kaizen, value stream mapping, Gemba, standard work, waste reduction, and continuous improvement routines.

- Strong ability to translate commercial and customer requirements into operational plans and scalable processes.

- Excellent leadership skills, with experience managing high-performing teams of specialists or transformation experts.

- Strong analytical capability, with the ability to turn operational data into strategic insight and measurable improvement.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills across Operations, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Customer Service, and regional leadership teams.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.

Jouw rol

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.

Wat je zal gaan doen: 

- Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.

- Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.

- Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.

- Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.

- Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.

- Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.

- Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes. 

- Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands .

Wat bieden wij jou?

- De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

- Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

- Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact.

- Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

- Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden.

- Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor.

- Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan.

- Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst.

- Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten.

- Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast .

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 .

Have a great day. Dawn Technology. 

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen Infrastructure Automation & Architecture) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. 

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior transformatieconsultant
description:
0,8 tot 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | € 5.086 - € 7.800 | Transformatie van organisaties | Wo 

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot 

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat. 

Als senior transformatieconsultant begeleid je complexe en vaak meerjarige veranderprogramma’s bij grote organisaties. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie en uitvoering, verbindt experts vanuit verschillende vakgebieden en helpt opdrachtgevers om het transitieproces met succes te implementeren. 

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling. 

Dit ga je doen 

Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan 

Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. Het doel is om de organisatie duurzaam anders te laten functioneren, zodat zij beter kan inspelen op nieuwe strategische uitdagingen. 

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse regie op omvangrijke verandertrajecten bij opdrachtgevers. Vaak gaat het om programma’s die meerdere jaren lopen en waarbij meerdere organisatieonderdelen betrokken zijn. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, organisatie-inrichting, processen & technologie, hr-processen, organisatiedynamiek en leiderschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat verandering niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd. 

Je verbindt mensen en expertise 

De kracht van Berenschot zit in de combinatie van verschillende expertises. Afhankelijk van de opgave werk je samen met collega's op het gebied van organisatieontwikkeling, hr, leiderschap, cultuur, data-analyse, functiewaardering, bedrijfsvoering en collega’s uit specifieke sectoren. Denk daarbij aan openbaar bestuur, bedrijfsleven en energie & leefomgeving. 

Jij brengt deze expertise samen rond één gezamenlijke ambitie. Je creëert structuur, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat mensen elkaar versterken en resultaten worden behaald. 

Je bent een vertrouwde gesprekspartner voor bestuurders 

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen. 

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen. 

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties 

Naast je opdrachten draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze propositie. Je deelt kennis, ontwikkelt nieuwe aanpakken en begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s in hun professionele groei. 

Hier kom je terecht

We’re looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong AWS and cloud security expertise to join our global Infrastructure Operations team.

You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams.

You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation.

- Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions

Strengthen AWS security with controls and policies across the organization, plus well designed IAM and network security rules

The best global media plans don’t simply roll out across markets—they connect a clear global direction with what works locally.

At WPP Media, we’re looking for a Global Client Director to bring that connection to life for a key international client. You’ll lead the day-to-day account operations and media planning delivery across markets, creating clarity, momentum and quality from brief through to measurement.

As part of our Global Client Solutions team in the Netherlands, you’ll work closely with the Senior Client Leadership Director, Client Manager and specialists across strategy, investment, activation, data and measurement. You’ll also bring diverse market teams together, helping them deliver connected, locally relevant work.

What you’ll do

Lead planning across markets

- Own the end-to-end media planning process, establishing clear planning cycles, ways of working, timelines, milestones, responsibilities and approval processes.

- Turn client briefs into actionable media briefs. Challenge gaps and align objectives, audiences, budgets, KPIs, deliverables and timings before planning begins.

- Translate global strategy and priorities into clear direction for local markets, creating consistency where it adds value while allowing for local insight and relevance.

- Bring strategy, audience insights, channel planning, investment, activation, data and measurement teams together to shape integrated recommendations.

- Review and challenge market plans, ensuring they’re strategically sound and clearly explain channel roles, audiences, investment levels, phasing and expected outcomes.

Keep delivery and learning on track

- Own the planning calendar and keep global and local teams aligned on deadlines, dependencies and next steps.

- Maintain visibility of media budgets, ensuring investment decisions and changes are clearly documented and communicated.

- Identify risks, missing inputs and potential delays early—and take action to keep delivery moving.

- Embed KPIs and measurement requirements into plans from the start, then turn results and market learnings into improvements for future planning.

- Continuously improve planning templates, workflows and governance to raise quality, consistency and efficiency.

Lead the client relationship and support growth

- Act as a senior day-to-day client contact, providing clear updates on planning progress, decisions, risks and next steps.

- Build strong relationships across client marketing, media, procurement and specialist teams, involving the right people at the right stages.

- Listen to client feedback and turn it into practical actions. Resolve issues proactively and escalate when needed, while keeping ownership clear.

- Support the Client Growth Plan by identifying opportunities to improve and expand the services WPP Media provides.

- Partner with commercial and investment leads on scope, resourcing, forecasting and profitability. Spot additional requirements early and ensure they’re appropriately scoped.

- Identify where WPP Media’s tools, platforms, data and specialist capabilities can strengthen the client’s planning and delivery.

A global mindset

Every market is different. Media landscapes, consumer behaviour, costs, channel maturity and local requirements vary from country to country. You’ll know how to create a consistent approach without applying a one-size-fits-all plan.

You’ll also bring markets together—sharing best practice and making sure individual market learnings help improve planning across the wider account.

What you’ll bring

- At least five years’ experience in client leadership, account management or media planning, ideally working with international or multi-market clients.

- A strong understanding of the end-to-end media planning process, from brief and strategy through channel planning, investment, activation and measurement.

- Experience coordinating planning processes, budgets, timelines and deliverables across multiple markets.

- The confidence to review and challenge media plans, and translate strategic direction into practical requirements for local teams.

- An understanding of how strategy, planning, investment, activation, data and measurement work together on an integrated media account.

- A structured, hands-on approach—and the ability to create clarity and accountability across multiple teams.

- Strong client, communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English.

- A collaborative, curious and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.

- Lunch and coffee: Affordable lunches in the staff canteen and freshly made coffee from our barista.

Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter.

At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer.

We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here.

At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience: from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair.

We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do.

What you'll be doing: 

Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance.

Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.

What you’ll be up to (some examples): 

- Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.

- Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.

- Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.

- Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.

- Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.

This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

Specifically, you bring: 

- 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).

- Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.

- Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.

- Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."

- Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).

- Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

Who this is not for: 

- You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week.

- You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here.

- You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit.

- A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months.

What we offer: 

- Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.

- In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam.

- Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy.

- Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team.

- Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe.

Our culture (read this carefully) 

We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace.

Our culture is defined by three things:

- High ownership 
People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it.

- High pace 
Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection.

- High standards 
Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through.

At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone .

We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface.

This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together: from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset.

We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here.

If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront.

title: Innovation Internship
description:
About the role 

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance.

As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

Your Responsibilities: 

- Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

- GHG reduction calculation : Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

- Policy Fit : asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

- Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

Your profile 

You recognize yourself in the following:

- Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

- Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

- Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

- Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

- Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

About SkyNRG 

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

- An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

- Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

- A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

- A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

- A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

- An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry.

- A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

- Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

- Commuting travel reimbursement.

- Paid Volunteering Day.

- Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it?

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Backend Platform team: 

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

- Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python.

- Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system.

- Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

- Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each.

- Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact.

- Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

- Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation.

- Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team.

- Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

- Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

- Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need: 

- Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both.

- Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance.

- Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind.

- Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs).

- Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes.

- Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production.

- A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking.

- Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them.

- Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early.

- Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good.

It would be great if you have: 

- Experience on a Platform or Core team.

- Strong production experience in both PHP and Python.

- Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper).

- Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts.

- Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems.

- Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools.

- Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants.

- Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams.

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. 

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. 

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. 

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. 

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager 

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role: 

- Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

- Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

- Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

- Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

- Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

- Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

- Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

- Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table: 

- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

- 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

- A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

- Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

- A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

- A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

- Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months: 

- You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

- Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

- Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

- Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

title: System Engineer (Control Systems)
description:
System Engineer – Machine Control 
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us 
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role 
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

- Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

- Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

- Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

- Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

- Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

- Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

- Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

- Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile 

- 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

- Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

- Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

- Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

- Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

- Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

- This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

- A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

- Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

- Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

- Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

- High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

- Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

- Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer 

- Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

- Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

- Competitive salary for the Dutch market

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

- Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop

- Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

- Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements

- Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets

- Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value

- Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer
