title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division . 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role 

- Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries. 

- Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.

- Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.

- Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You 

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have) 

- Advanced degree ( Master's or PhD ) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics , or a related quantitative field 

- Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.

- Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

- Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets. 

- Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

- Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions. 

- Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer 

- Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

- Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

- Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

- Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

- Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

- Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career 

Why Join Flix? 

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. 

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Social-Media-Agentur, ein Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen und digitales Mediennetzwerk – und zählt zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für Marken aus Entertainment, Sport und Industrie (u. a. ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus oder Creators wie Matthias Malmedie).

Vom Standort München aus sind wir Teil eines globalen Teams von über 500 Digital-Expert*innen in UK, US, Deutschland und APAC. Gemeinsam betreuen wir mehr als 1.000 digitale Kanäle, betreiben über 250 eigene Social-Media- und sechs FAST-Channels und generieren weltweit über 11 Milliarden organische Views pro Monat . Damit diese Inhalte ihre Ziele erreichen, brauchen wir genau dich in unserem Team Data & Insights !

Für unsere Team am Standort München oder remote deutschlandweit suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (25 Std./Woche) – zunächst befristet auf 1 Jahr (mit Perspektive auf Verlängerung).

Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Daten, Analysen und das Erlernen neuer Fähigkeiten. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Aufgaben

- Datenanalyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du analysierst und verarbeitest große Datenmengen rund um Social Media, SEO, Paid Search und digitales Marketing, behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

- Datenmodellierung & Automatisierung: Du baust saubere Datenmodelle in Google BigQuery , verarbeitest Daten mit SQL und Python , bindest Datenquellen über APIs an und entwickelst automatisierte Reportings sowie interaktive Dashboards in Looker .

- Schnittstelle zu Kreativ- & Mediateams: Du übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in verständliche Storys, präsentierst deine Erkenntnisse souverän und unterstützt unsere Projekt-, Kreativ- und Mediateams dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

- Vielfältige Kundenprojekte: Du treibst eigene Daten- und Insights-Projekte für ein breites Portfolio an Kunden voran – sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im engen Austausch mit unseren Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen.

Qualifikation

- Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data/Marketing Analytics, BI, Digital Marketing oder einem verwandten Umfeld (z. B. Traffic Management).

- Tech- & Daten-Skills: Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung mit SQL und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery .

- Social- & Reporting-Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit YouTube Analytics , der Meta Business Suite und gängigen BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio ).

- Development-Grundlagen: Erste Erfahrungen oder ein gutes Grundverständnis im Bereich Software Engineering / API-Anbindung.

- Storytelling mit Daten: Du kannst komplexe technische Analysen so aufbereiten und erklären, dass auch nicht-technische Teams sie sofort verstehen und nutzen können.

- Mindset: Du arbeitest akribisch, gut organisiert und proaktiv, denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hast ein echtes Gespür für Social Media und internationale Trends.

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice-to-have (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus): 

- Erfahrung mit spezialisierten Python-Libraries (z. B. Mito oder Zeitreihenanalysen mit ARIMA ).

- Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise .

Benefits

- Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Analysen aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere strategischen Entscheidungen maßgeblich zu prägen.

- Liefere datenbasierte Impulse: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, Zielgruppen und Markttrends tiefgehend zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. (Angepasst von „Trends deiner Generation“) 

- Sorge für deine Zukunft vor: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) unterstützen wir dich dabei, schon heute langfristig und sicher für morgen zu planen. (Neu ergänzt) 

- Bleib fit und gesund: Mit dem EGYM Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, körperlich und mental in Bestform zu bleiben.

- Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine gute Balance – du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, mobil im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

- Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld: Unser Team vereint entspannte Atmosphäre mit ehrgeizigen Zielen – hier gehen Spaß an der Arbeit und Erfolg Hand in Hand.

- Erkunde vielfältige Inhalte: Mit einer breiten Palette an Themen, von Sport über True Crime bis hin zu Nachhaltigkeit, bieten wir ein spannendes Umfeld, das weit über trockene Zahlen hinausgeht.

- Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – wir kommen regelmäßig zusammen, nicht nur in Meetings, sondern auch bei Team-Events, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken.

- Genieße die Atmosphäre im Büro: Unser Büro in der Macherei bietet nicht nur hervorragenden Kaffee, sondern auch die Gelegenheit, nach der Arbeit bei einem gemeinsamen Getränk zu entspannen.

title: Venture Development
description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

- 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

- ~110 people on the team in Munich

- €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger. 

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff. 

Why this role exists 

We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff).

Why your role matters 

- You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company.

- You see every part of the company. You interact with Sales, Tech and Customer Value roles and learn fast what great looks like in each.

- AI does the groundwork, you bring the judgement. Our agents search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, check what they find and raise their bar.

- You grow as fast as you deliver. 70%+ of our leadership team was promoted internally. After your first year, you shape your own path: in Talent, Ops, Tech or in a commercial role.

What your week looks like 

- Interviews: about 40%

- Steering and reviewing sourcing: about 20%

- Candidate communication and scheduling: about 10%

- Events, campaigns, merch and employer branding: about 20%

- Other: about 10%

What this role is and isn’t 

- Hands on: The first 9 to 12 months are about execution: many interviews and candidate calls, clean pipelines and events that run smoothly. It's not always glamorous, but some of the highest leverage work at Tacto and that's how we like it.

- Not a closing role: Offers and final negotiations sit with our Chief of Staff and the hiring managers. Your job is to bring the right people to the final round, with a clear picture of who they are and making sure that everybody is aligned to provide the best possible candidate experience we can.

- Not a strategy role: Those don’t exist at Tacto. It is also not a short stop: we look for people who want to grow here. Where you want to grow and into which direction you want to take your career is up to you to define. 

- The deal: Prove yourself with real impact, and we back your growth in every way we can.

Your tasks

- Own your pipelines and build the org: You own a few open roles at a time, often in very different teams. You agree with each hiring manager on who we are looking for and keep the pipeline moving until the final interview.

- Interview and assess: You run first interviews, judge fit against a clear bar and give hiring managers a sharp recommendation.

- Orchestrate sourcing: Our AI skills search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, review what they find and source yourself where it counts.

- Turn candidates into fans: You make our process fast, personal and honest, from the first message to the final interview. Even the people we say no to should walk away telling their friends to apply.

- Build a base that scales: You set up job descriptions, interview plans, pipelines and data that let us grow the team without losing speed or quality. What you build today is how Tacto hires tomorrow.

- Shape how Tacto shows up: You help run our talent events, from hackathons and university partnerships to invite-only dinners and Lunch & Learns, plus campaigns, merch and employer branding.

- Grow into company building: Once the basics run, you take on additional projects with our Chief of Staff. Your path is yours to define in this role and you will receive all the support needed to make it happen.

Your profile

Experience and skills 

- Experience: Ideally 1 to 2 years of work experience, but not required

- High bar: You’ve seen what great looks like, through an internship or role at a top startup, in consulting or in VC

- AI native: You already use AI in your daily work and want to build with it, not just use it

- Languages: Fluent German and English

Core strengths 

- People intuition: You read people fast, connect easily and build trust

- Storyteller: You sell a vision and get others excited to join it

- Hands on: You solve problems yourself instead of only talking about them

- Hungry and fast: You get energy from moving fast and seeing results

- Curious about company building: You want to understand how companies grow and can see yourself in Talent or org building long term

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. 

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

- We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

- Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

- Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

- Real passion: Grit and ownership.

- Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

- Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

- Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect 

- Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

- Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

- Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events, for example with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or at large hackathons. All events: luma.com/tacto 

Benefits 

- €1,500+ learning budget per year

- 26 + 4 days of vacation

- €300 childcare allowance per child

- EGYM Wellpass

- JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

- Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

- Intro Call , 20 min, with the People Team

- Hiring Manager Interview , 30 min, with Marla (Chief of Staff)

- Mini Task , 30 min prep + 30 min call, with Marla

- Onsite Case and Meet the Team , 4-5h prep + 1.5h at our office, with Marla, André, and two people from the team

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background 

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters 

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer 

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

- Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

- Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

- Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

- Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

- Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

- Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

description:

Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

About JetBrains 

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks 

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role 

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on 

- Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

- Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

- Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

- Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

- Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

- Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

- Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

- Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.

- Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.

- Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

- Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer 

- A competitive salary and strong benefits package.

- The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.

- A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.

- Real users and real workflows from day one.

- Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.

title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
description:
Job description

Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager

Our Mission 

At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.

From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.

Your Role 

We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.

The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.

Key responsibilities 

- 
Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.

- 
Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.

- 
Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.

- 
Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.

- 
Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.

- 
Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.

- 
Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.

- 
Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.

- 
Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.

- 
Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.

Job requirements

About you 

Required: 

- 
Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

- 
Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.

- 
Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.

- 
Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).

- 
Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.

- 
Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).

- 
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.

- 
Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.

- 
Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.

- 
Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

- 
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have : 

- 
Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).

- 
Exposure to high-growth or start-up aerospace environments.

- 
Broader understanding of end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles.

Why join constellr? 

- High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.

- Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.

- Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.

- Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.

- Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
description:
About Abacum 

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning! 

We are looking for... 

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will... 

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need... 

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have... 

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum 

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get 

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits 

- Competitive compensation including equity package

- Competitive vacation policy

- Medical Insurance

- L&D budget

- Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

- Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values 

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

title: Implementation Manager - German Speaking (m/w/d)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns: 

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung: 

- Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

- Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

- Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

- Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

- Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

- Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

- Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt entweder in Berlin, München oder komplett remote in Deutschland; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit: 

- In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

- Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden.

- Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys.

- Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends.

- Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

- Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden.

- Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.

- Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

- Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil.

- Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

- Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil.

Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten.

Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. 

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build. 

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change. 

Your roadmap to make an impact

- The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air. 

- Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand. 

- System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery. 

- HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements. 

- Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL. 

- HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks. 

- 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for 

- Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs 

- Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components 

- Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control 

- Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed 

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience 

Nice to haves

- Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL 

- HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat 

- Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection 

- Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement 

- Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA 

- FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation 

- MAVLink and flight controller interfaces 

- GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation 

- Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing 

- Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts 

- Rust for performance-critical test components 

- Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers 

- End-of-line test stations 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us 

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Make impact. Be human. Stay curious. 

Who we are 

Founded in 2006, Rewire is an applied AI company helping organizations reinvent how they work with data and AI. We partner with leading organizations across industries to create scalable business impact by solving complex challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our team of 100+ data scientists, engineers, and change agents operates across Europe from offices in the Netherlands and Germany. Strategic in intent and pragmatic in execution, we combine deep Data & AI expertise with close, committed collaboration.

Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are at the heart of our culture. Through topic communities, expert colleagues, and our internal academy, GAIN, you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills in areas such as Agentic AI, Data Strategy, AI Product Development, and Technology Platforms, while helping clients achieve measurable results.

Join a team that loves learning, solving challenges together, and having fun along the way. Ready to join the ride? 

Where you’ll make a difference 

- Build robust data & AI infrastructure – design and develop the pipelines, platforms, and systems that power our clients' data-driven ambitions

- Advise clients on technical best practices – translate business needs into sound engineering decisions, bridging the gap between strategy and implementation

- Develop scalable software solutions – write clean, maintainable code that turns complex requirements into reliable, production-ready systems

- Contribute to organizational change – implement data & AI innovations supported by GAIN®, our certified education and training portfolio

- Use technical expertise and communication skills – build scalable data & AI solutions that drive value across the organization

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams from both the client and Rewire – contribute from day one while learning from experienced leaders

What makes us the right choice for you 

- Be part of groundbreaking change as we scale a business in a fast-evolving industry with a dedicated international growth strategy, a team of experts, and the support of an experienced investor

- Step into a role where you contribute ideas, support innovation, and help shape how organizations use data & AI to create real impact

- Sharpen your engineering craft – work with modern tech stacks, cloud platforms, and best practices across diverse industries, while growing through hands-on projects and mentorship from experienced engineers

- Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand

- Work alongside clients as a valued team member – building relationships based on trust, shared goals, and face-to-face collaboration whenever it matters most

- Thrive in a culture that values autonomy, curiosity, and bold thinking – where your voice matters, ideas turn into action, and your impact is genuinely recognized and rewarded

What makes you shine 

You’re a motivated problem solver and a curious learner – with a passion for turning data & AI into real business impact. You’ll thrive with us if you bring:

- A Master’s degree with excellent results in a quantitative or STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering)

- Practical experience through internships, projects, or research – demonstrating your ability to build and maintain data pipelines, design scalable systems, and deliver reliable, production-ready solutions

- A hands-on, growth mindset – you take ownership of your tasks, embrace challenges, and contribute to solutions that create real value

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit – you enjoy working in teams, explaining technical concepts clearly, and supporting a positive, inclusive work environment

If you're hesitating because you don't meet every requirement, don't let that hold you back. Strong candidates often underestimate how well they fit a role. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply! 

Where you’ll work 

Many projects require working onsite at client locations throughout Germany (and occasionally Europe) for several days per week . Travel requirements vary depending on the project and client needs .

While our main office is located in Heidelberg, many of our team members are based across various cities in Germany. This reflects our flexible and distributed team structure, which means that relocation is not required.
At the same time, as we continue to grow our Heidelberg office, being located within reasonable travel distance is an advantage and helps facilitate collaboration.

“What I really enjoy about my job at Rewire is us being involved from the beginning to the end of implementing complex and innovative AI solutions. We go from designing, to prototyping, to implementing at scale. As a result, working here exposes me to so many aspects of engineering that I find incredibly interesting. Secondly, working with the people here is simply a great deal of fun.” – Jacco Broere, Senior Data Engineer & AI at Rewire 

Sound like your kind of team? 

Perfect! If you’re ready to kick-start your career and want to make real impact with data & AI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now! And let’s see where this journey takes us.

Questions? Feel free to ask them via ----- – we’re happy to chat.

Who you are matters to us! 

We welcome all applicants – regardless of gender, background, or LGBT+ identity – because diversity and inclusion are core values for us. We are convinced that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and success. 

We believe diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to building a more diverse engineering team and particularly encourage women and other underrepresented groups in technology to apply.

title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. 

What will your job look like: 

- Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. 

- Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components.

- Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.

- Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).

- Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.

- Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack.

- Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware.

All you need is: 

- Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field. 

- 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work.

- Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel.

- Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout.

- Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch).

- Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image.

- Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.

- Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup.

Nice to have: 

- Background in Automotive Software.

- Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).

- Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

title: Director of Industrialisation
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability 

At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

Getting complex hardware through development and into flight is one challenge. Building the industrial capability to deliver it repeatedly, at the required quality and rate, is another. We’re looking for a Director of Industrialisation to lead that work in Germany.

You’ll take a greenfield manufacturing site from an empty floor to sustained series production. You’ll shape the facility, decide what we build in-house, bring in the equipment and people, and lead the ramp until the operation can deliver reliably. Your job starts while the product is still taking shape, when the right manufacturing decision can save months of work later.

We’re looking for someone who’s done this before and wants to build again. You’ll work directly with the founders and with Engineering, Programmes, Quality, Supply Chain and Operations. You’ll be close enough to the floor to see where the plan is breaking down, and senior enough to make the decisions that fix it.

What you’ll do 

- 
Own the industrialisation plan. Translate programme demand into a plan for capacity, capital investment, people and suppliers. Set milestones from facility readiness through pilot builds and production ramp, and make the trade-offs visible when timelines or assumptions change.

- 
Build and commission the operation. Define what the site needs to support, shape the layout and material flow, and lead equipment selection, installation and commissioning. Plan how the operation will expand as demand grows.

- 
Bring manufacturing into product decisions early. Work with Engineering to make the hardware practical to build, inspect and test. Bring evidence from the floor into design reviews, and agree how changes will be introduced as the design matures.

- 
Decide what to make and what to buy. Work with Supply Chain to establish which capabilities we need to own, where specialist suppliers make sense, and how we qualify and scale those suppliers alongside our own production.

- 
Take pilot builds into repeatable production. Use early builds to expose what will limit output. Resolve bottlenecks, improve yield and build consistency, and demonstrate that the operation can sustain its target rate across successive builds.

- 
Build the team and the way it works. Hire the people who will establish the operation. Give them clear ownership, develop leaders on the floor, and put in place the training and routines that let the team solve problems as production grows.

- 
Own manufacturing readiness. Define the evidence needed before increasing the rate, from process capability and trained operators to supplier readiness, inspection and traceability. Work with Quality and Safety to build those requirements into everyday work.

- 
Make the hard calls. Decide where automation earns its place, where a simpler process gets us there sooner, and where to commit capital before all the answers are in. Give leadership a clear view of what’s on track, what’s at risk and what decision is needed.

Who you are 

- 
You’ve personally led a greenfield site or a major production operation built from scratch, through commissioning and into sustained series or volume production. You can tell us what existed on day one, what you owned and what the operation was delivering once it ramped.

- 
You’ve industrialised complex hardware while the design was still evolving. You know how to keep engineering and manufacturing moving together when a design change affects tooling, suppliers, inspection or the delivery plan.

- 
You’ve made consequential capital, capacity and staffing decisions. You can explain what you committed to early, what you deliberately kept flexible and how those choices played out.

- 
You’ve lived through a difficult ramp. You can talk us through a target you missed, how you found the real constraint, what you changed and what happened to output, yield, cost or delivery as a result.

- 
You’ve built and led teams across disciplines. You can earn the trust of operators, technicians and engineers, challenge a design decision with evidence, and explain a manufacturing trade-off to the founders in plain language.

- 
You know how to build at pace in a demanding hardware environment. You put the controls that matter in place early, and keep decisions close to the people doing the work.

- 
You’re motivated by the opportunity to build industrial capability for European defence, and you want to be on site with the team doing it.

Where you might have done it 
You might have launched a new factory in automotive, built a production operation at a hardware startup, or taken an aerospace or advanced manufacturing product from low-rate builds to series production.

You could have done it inside a larger company if you had the mandate to build the operation and were personally accountable for the ramp.The common thread is the build itself. We want to hear about the operation you created, how quickly you brought it online, the rate it sustained and the decisions you made when the original plan met reality.

What we offer 

- 
Genuine ownership of the industrialisation of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes, from an empty site to sustained series production.

- 
The chance to join early enough that your decisions will shape the factory, the team and how Hypersonica manufactures for years to come.

- 
Direct access to the founders and the factory floor, with short decision paths and the authority to act when you see a better way to build.

- 
Daily collaboration with exceptional people across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test and Programmes. You’ll have a seat at the table while the product is still taking shape.

- 
The freedom to challenge convention and build from first principles, from what we make in-house to where automation earns its place.

- 
The resources and ambition to build a production operation at a pace that would be hard to match in a traditional aerospace organisation.

- 
The chance to see your decisions through, from the first factory layout on a whiteboard to hardware coming off a line that delivers reliably, shift after shift.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
description:
The role 

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

You will... 

- Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.

- Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.

- Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.

- Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are.... 

- An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.

- Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.

- A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.

- Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.

- Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have.... 

- 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.

- Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.

- Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.

- Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.

- Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have: 

- Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.

- Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

What we offer 

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Agentic & Applied AI
description:
Über uns: 

HyPlus ist Dein Wegbegleiter im digitalen Wandel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert, deren digitale DNA. Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in Automotive, Handel, Banken & Versicherungen sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor.

Bei uns ist KI kein Innovationstheater. Wir betreiben einen eigenen GPU-Server, hosten Modelle selbst, betreiben einen eigenen AI Gateway und bauen für Kunden – insb. aus der Versicherungswirtschaft - Prozesse, die täglich echte Fälle entscheiden. Unser Center of Excellence AI ist die Stelle, an der neue Technologien zuerst ankommen, bewertet und dann in Projekte und in eine Guidance für unsere Mitarbeitenden übersetzt werden.

Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der/die wirklich tief drin ist: eine Person, die neue Modelle, Frameworks und Werkzeuge früh entdeckt, sie selbst ausprobiert und danach begründen kann, was davon in einem regulierten Unternehmensumfeld trägt und was nicht. Ungefähr 70 % der Zeit arbeitest du direkt in Kundenprojekten, rund 30 % gehören dem Center of Excellence (CoE) und damit der Frage, wo wir in achtzehn Monaten stehen.

Deine Aufgaben in Kundenprojekten: 

- Agentische Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwirfst und entwickelst Agenten und Workflows entlang realer Fachprozesse, beispielsweise für Schadenmeldungen, Dokumentenprüfungen oder Kunden-Onboarding, und entscheidest, wann KI oder klassische Logik sinnvoll ist

- LLM- und Bild-KI-Module: Du integrierst Text-, Dokumenten- und Bildverarbeitung als API-basierte Module in produktive Anwendungen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Datenanreicherung

- Qualität messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testdatensätze, definierst Qualitätsmetriken und etablierst Regressionstests, um die Leistung von Modellen und Prompts messbar und zuverlässig zu machen

- Architektur und Integration: Du integrierst KI-Komponenten in bestehende IT-Landschaften und triffst nachvollziehbare Architekturentscheidungen

- Betrieb, Sicherheit und Compliance: Du verantwortest das Hosting von KI-Modellen auf eigener GPU-Infrastruktur sowie den AI Gateway und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Sicherheit und EU AI Act

- Inferenz-Betrieb und AI-DevOps: Du betreibst und optimierst offene KI-Modelle mit Technologien wie Ollama, vLLM, SGLang und TGI sowie Docker und Kubernetes und verantwortest automatisierte Deployments, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle

- Sparring im Presales: Du begleitest Kundentermine und Workshops, berätst Fachbereiche und bewertest technische Möglichkeiten, Kosten und Risiken

Deine Aufgaben im Center of Excellence: 

- Technologie-Radar: Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen, testest neue Lösungen und bewertest deren Nutzen für unser Unternehmen

- Referenzimplementierungen: Du entwickelst wieder verwendbare KI-Bausteine, Blueprints und Best Practices für unsere Projektteams

- Eigene Inferenz-Plattform weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst unseren Modell-Stack und AI Gateway weiter, vergleichst Modelle und Inferenz-Technologien und schaffst Grundlagen für fundierte Technologieentscheidungen

- Standards und Kostenkontrolle: Du definierst Standards für Prompt- und Agent-Engineering, Modellauswahl, Betriebskosten und Sicherheit und dokumentierst diese zentral

- Befähigung in die Breite: Du vermittelst dein Wissen durch Schulungen, Demos und praxisnahe Leitlinien an unsere Mitarbeitenden

- Vom Wissen zum Angebot: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns aus neuen Erkenntnissen marktfähige KI-Angebote und Services

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im IT- oder MINT-nahen Umfeld oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- ≥ 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Software-, Data- oder ML-Engineer, davon mindestens 18 Monate mit produktiven LLM-basierten Systemen

- Erfahrung mit mindestens einem produktiv eingesetzten agentischen System oder Workflow sowie mit RAG-Architekturen und der Bewertung ihrer Retrieval-Qualität

- Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2 Niveau und Englischkenntnisse auf B2 Niveau

- 20% Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Kunden bei Bedarf

- Deutscher Wohnsitz

- Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit APIs, Integrationen, Git, CI/CD, Containern und SQL

- Praxis im Betrieb offener KI-Modelle wie vLLM, Ollama, TGI oder SGLang sowie Kenntnisse in GPU-Dimensionierung, Quantisierung und Sprachmodellen wie Whisper

- Erfahrung mit DevOps und MLOps im KI-Umfeld, insbesondere Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD und Monitoring

- Verständnis von Modell-Adaption und Fine-Tuning, beispielsweise LoRA, Datenaufbereitung und Evaluation, sowie die Fähigkeit, den tatsächlichen Nutzen einzuschätzen

- Selbstverständlicher Einsatz von Coding-Agenten wie Claude Code und ein gutes Verständnis ihrer Möglichkeiten und Grenzen

- Fähigkeit, Benchmarks kritisch zu bewerten, eigene Evaluationen durchzuführen und fundierte Technologieentscheidungen zu treffen

- Grundkenntnisse in Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit im Unternehmensumfeld, insbesondere DSGVO, Auftragsverarbeitung und Mitbestimmung

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit Versicherungs-, Schaden- oder Gutachterprozessen oder vergleichbaren regulierten Branchen

- Kenntnisse in Computer Vision zur Schaden- und Zustandserkennung auf Bildern und Videos

- Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Dokumenten- und OCR-Pipelines

- Kenntnisse in Oracle, APEX, .NET/C# oder Azure

- Erfahrung mit skalierbarem Inferenz-Betrieb, GPU-Sharing, Multi-GPU-Serving, Autoscaling und Performance-Optimierung

- Erfahrung im eigenen Modelltraining oder Fine-Tuning inklusive Datenaufbereitung

- Engagement in der KI-Community durch Open-Source-Beiträge, Vorträge, Veröffentlichungen oder eigene Experimente

Das erwartet dich: 

- Attraktive Vergütung & Benefits – wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Gesundheitsbudget, Team-Offsites, moderne Tech-Ausstattung, Mobilitätspaket, Jobrad etc.

- Karriereperspektive – klar definierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten & Jahresgespräche

- Weiterentwicklung – kontinuierliche Trainings, Zertifizierungen und Zugang zu Branchen-Events

- Flexibilität – Hybrid-/Remote-Modell, flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Unternehmenskultur – kollegiales, politikarmes Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen und Ergebnisse zählen

- Innovation mit Freiraum – eigene GPU-Infrastruktur und ausdrücklich geschützte Zeit zum Experimentieren. Innovation ist Teil deiner Rolle, nicht Freizeitbeschäftigung

- Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung – ein CoE-Mandat mit echtem Einfluss: Du prägst Standards und Guidance für rund 800 Mitarbeitende

Chancengleichheit: 

HyPlus ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns aktiv für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden willkommen und wertgeschätzt fühlen.

-> Statt eines Anschreibens interessiert uns, wie du denkst: 

Schicke uns zusammen mit deinem Profil bitte eine knappe Seite mit drei Punkten:

- Drei Technologien, Modelle oder Werkzeuge, die dir in den letzten sechs Monaten wichtig geworden sind und was sie konkret für ein Unternehmen wie uns bedeuten

- Eine Sache, die du ausprobiert und danach bewusst verworfen hast, mit deiner Begründung
