Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. 

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous 

Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.

Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.

Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée.

Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail. 

Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène. 

Le deuxième axe de travail porte sur le développement d'un modèle quantitatif pour l'analyse par Auger de la ségrégation intergranulaire des éléments d'alliages. Il s'agira d'une approche similaire à celle déjà développée pour le phosphore et le soufre, avec la difficulté supplémentaire de soustraire la contribution du volume, ici non-négligeable. 

Les troisième et quatrième axes de ce post-doc s'appuient sur le spectromètre Auger installé en décembre 2025. Cet équipement de dernière génération présente une résolution latérale inférieure à 10 nm. Ceci ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyses que nous souhaitons explorer dans le cadre de la chaire, en particulier concernant l'analyse du carbone et des carbures, qui constitue le troisième axe de travail de ce post-doc. L'analyse Auger de la surface des carbures nanométriques devient possible avec le nouvel instrument et permet d'accéder à la composition chimique des interfaces carbures-matrice. De plus, l'analyse Auger des facettes intergranulaires pourra être faite en-dehors des carbures et permettra d'accéder à la quantification du carbone ségrégé dans le joint. 

Enfin, le dernier axe de travail consistera à développer une méthode de quantification de la ségrégation intergranulaire sans rupture. Il s’agira de travailler ici sur une coupe polie du matériau à étudier et à réaliser des analyses locales, par exemple des profils de concentrations à travers les joints de grains. 

Compte tenu de l'excellente résolution latérale, on peut ainsi espérer détecter la ségrégation par cette méthode. Une méthode de traitement des données devra être développée pour accéder à des concentrations intergranulaires de solutés. Une telle méthode a déjà été mise au point pour des analyses réalisées par nanoSIMS et pourrait être transposée sur la spectrométrie Auger. Elle permettrait de s’affranchir de la nécessité d'obtenir une rupture intergranulaire (particulièrement limitante en spectrométrie Auger), tout en conservant une préparation d’échantillon très simple (coupe polie) et une productivité potentiellement importante (grand nombre de joints analysables dans un échantillon donné).

description:
Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA

Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE 

Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois) 

Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie

Contexte :

École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants :

- Systèmes Numériques

- Energie Environnement

- Matériaux et Procédés

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr .

Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air.

Contexte :

L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. Ces méthodes permettent une mesure en temps réel, pour capturer la variabilité temporelle du NH3. Cependant, le NH3 est un polluant particulièrement complexe à mesurer notamment en raison de difficultés métrologiques (absence de méthode standardisée, interférences etc.) et de ses propriétés physico-chimiques (grande réactivité avec les surfaces, volatilisation, formation de particules etc.).

Objectif :

L'objectif de ce stage est d’apporter des éléments méthodologiques qui permettront d’établir des recommandations nationales concernant la sélection et les pratiques de mise en œuvre des préleveurs automatiques, afin d’améliorer la fiabilité et l’harmonisation des mesures de l’ammoniac.

Livrables :

· Synthèse bibliographique ciblée sur les difficultés métrologiques de la mesure du NH₃ et les solutions à évaluer

· Production d’un plan d’expériences détaillé à suivre durant le stage et d’un protocole d’assurance et de contrôle qualité des données.

· Jeu de données documenté, fichiers ou scripts de traitement reproductibles et bilan des performances observées.

· Présentation des résultats au groupe de travail national pour la mesure de NH3

· Projet de note de recommandations pour le prélèvement de NH₃ en zone rurale, soumis à la validation des encadrants et du groupe de travail national. Les conclusions distingueront les points établis des points restant à confirmer.

Profil du candidat : 

Ce stage est destiné à un.e étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou M2 universitaire avec un profil en analyses physico-chimiques, en instrumentation, mesure et assurance qualité appliquées à l’environnement, avec un goût prononcé pour les approches expérimentales.

De grandes qualités d’analyse, de rédaction, d’organisation, de communication et d’autonomie sont attendues.

Curiosité scientifique, rigueur et aptitude au travail en équipe sont recherchées. Un bon niveau d’anglais scientifique est souhaité pour la lecture bibliographique. Des compétences en traitement de données (Python, R ou Matlab) seront appréciées. Une première pratique de la chimie analytique et des notions de métrologie et d’assurance qualité seront des atouts.

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/03/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois

title: Security Engineer
description:
About Prelude 

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us 

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values 

- Care
We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

- Bias for Action
We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

- Ownership
We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

When your product is the front door to someone else’s product, security isn’t a feature, it’s the product. Every login and every signup that goes through Prelude is a moment where our customers trust us with their users, their phone numbers, and their reputation.

As our first dedicated Security Engineer, you’ll own security across Prelude: our cloud infrastructure, our codebase, our APIs and SDKs, and the way we handle the sensitive data that flows through them. You’ll start from solid ground: a certified ISO 27001 and SOC 2 program, short-lived credentials across our cloud environment, and a 24/7 on-call rotation. You’ll run that foundation day to day and take it further, with direct support from Engineering leadership and the founders.

This is a hands-on IC role: you’ll write code, ship guardrails, and fix things yourself, and set the standard for how every engineer at Prelude thinks about security.

What you’ll do

Own the security of our cloud infrastructure. Harden our AWS and ClickHouse environments and make the secure path the default for every service we deploy.

Build security into how we ship. Run threat modeling and design reviews with engineers, review critical code paths, and extend our automated checks in CI/CD (adding dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and IaC security scanning) without slowing the team down.

Protect our customers’ users and their data. Personal data is at the heart of our product. Design and enforce the controls that protect it (encryption, access control, retention, and auditability) in line with GDPR and our customers’ expectations.

Mature detection and incident response. Extend our logging, alerting, and runbooks to spot abuse and compromise early, lead incident response when something goes wrong, and write honest post-mortems the next morning.

Drive compliance and customer trust. Maintain and mature our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications through surveillance and recertification audits. Own our answers to enterprise security questionnaires, and be the technical voice of Prelude’s security posture with our largest customers.

Partner with our anti-fraud team. Fraud here isn’t theoretical. Work alongside the engineers fighting SMS pumping, toll fraud, bot traffic, and account takeover attempts in production, bringing an attacker’s mindset to the problems at the core of our product.

Use AI to multiply your impact. AI is already part of how we build. Make it part of how we defend: automate triage, log analysis, questionnaire answers, and code review so a team of one can operate like a team of five.

Join the on-call rotation for the systems you secure.

What we’re looking for

- 4+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud and infrastructure security, ideally at a fast-growing tech company

- Hands-on experience securing AWS in production (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, or equivalent), and comfort working with infrastructure as code

- Strong software engineering skills: you can read and write production code, ideally in Go or TypeScript, and fix vulnerabilities yourself rather than just filing tickets

- Solid knowledge of web and API security (OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization flows, rate limiting, abuse prevention)

- Experience building or running security programs pragmatically: you know which 20% of controls cover 80% of the risk at a company our size

- Experience with incident response and with setting up logging, monitoring, and alerting

- A builder’s mindset: you prefer guardrails and automation over gatekeeping, and engineers see you as a partner, not a blocker

- Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain risk to an engineer, a founder, and a customer’s CISO

- Professional fluency in English, the working language of our international team

Nice to have

- Experience maintaining SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001 certifications through audit cycles

- Background in identity, authentication, fintech, telecom, or another regulated or high-stakes domain

- Familiarity with fraud and abuse patterns (SMS pumping, bot traffic, account takeover)

- Penetration testing or red team experience, or a track record in bug bounty programs

- Knowledge of telecom protocols and ecosystem risks (SMPP, SS7, SIM swap)

- Experience with Connect/gRPC and Protobuf, Rust, or AWS serverless architectures

- French is a plus, not a requirement

Tech stack

- Languages: Go, TypeScript, React

- Infrastructure and data: AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, SQS), ClickHouse, Connect RPC and Protobuf

- Infrastructure as code and CI: AWS CDK (Go), GitHub Actions

- Observability: OpenTelemetry, Grafana

- Build: Bazel

- AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever comes next

title: Consultant(e) Senior RP Corporate
description:
Who we are: 

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Qui sommes-nous: 

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram .

En savoir plus sur le rôle: 

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre département Corporate , composé d’une équipe de 10 consultants passionnés, qui accompagnent des entreprises françaises et internationales dans la gestion de leur réputation.

Dans un environnement stimulant, vous accompagnerez des organisations issues de secteurs variés, contribuerez activement au développement de nouveaux comptes et participerez au renforcement de notre expertise corporate.

Conseil stratégique et accompagnement client

Participer activement à l’élaboration de recommandations stratégiques et de plans d’actions.

Accompagner les clients sur leurs enjeux de réputation, de visibilité et de transformation.

- 
Développer des positionnements, plateformes de messages, éléments de langage et narratifs adaptés aux différents publics cibles.

- 
Anticiper les besoins des clients, identifier les risques et leur apporter des recommandations proactives et opérationnelles.

- 
Contribuer à la qualité de la relation conseil au quotidien avec les clients.

Relations avec les parties prenantes et influence 

- 
Concevoir et déployer des programmes de relations avec les parties prenantes des clients, y compris avec les médias : veille stratégique, identification d’opportunités éditoriales, campagnes de médiatisation et dispositifs de visibilité.

- 
Piloter les relations avec les journalistes, médias clés, leaders d’opinion et créateurs de contenus pertinents pour les clients.

- 
Organiser interviews, événements presse, rencontres éditoriales et partenariats de brand content.

- 
Développer et entretenir un réseau solide de journalistes, médias et influenceurs, en France comme à l’international.

Production de contenus et excellence rédactionnelle 

- 
Rédiger et/ou superviser la production de contenus à forte valeur ajoutée : communiqués de presse, pitchs médias, tribunes, dossiers de presse, livres blancs, FAQ, articles d’expertise, prises de parole de dirigeants ou contenus digitaux.

- 
Garantir la qualité rédactionnelle des livrables clients et accompagner les équipes dans l’amélioration continue de leurs productions écrites.

Gestion de projet et coordination 

- 
Assurer le pilotage opérationnel des programmes confiés : suivi des budgets, gestion des délais et reporting client.

- 
Veiller à la performance des actions mises en œuvre et à la satisfaction des clients.

- 
Contribuer à la rentabilité des comptes et au développement durable des relations clients.

Développement commercial et développement de l’expertise 

- 
Participer activement aux réflexions stratégiques, aux brainstormings et aux travaux de recherche nécessaires aux recommandations.

- 
Contribuer à la préparation des propositions commerciales, des appels d’offres et des soutenances de new business.

- 
Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de développement auprès des clients existants et prospects.

- 
Participer au rayonnement de l’expertise Corporate de l’agence et contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein des équipes.

Collaboration transverse 

- Travailler étroitement avec les autres expertises de l’agence afin de proposer des dispositifs de communication intégrés et innovants.

Profil recherché : 

- 
Vous justifiez de 4 à 6 années d’expérience en agence de communication ou de relations publics, ou au sein de la Direction de la communication d’une entreprise, avec une expertise reconnue sur les enjeux de réputation et communication corporate . 

- 
Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Bac +3 à Bac +5 (type IEP, droit, affaires publiques, écoles de commerce, sciences politiques). 

- 
Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension des enjeux de communication interne, marque employeur, conduite du changement et engagement des collaborateurs . 

- 
Vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de relations médias, les stratégies d’influence ainsi que la production de contenus corporate. 

- 
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d’analyse, votre sens du conseil et votre aptitude à transformer des problématiques complexes en recommandations concrètes et impactantes. 

- 
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français à l’écrit comme à l’oral et êtes capable de travailler quotidiennement en anglais, dans un contexte international. 

- 
Créatif(ve), curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous aimez imaginer de nouveaux dispositifs et faire émerger des idées différenciantes. 

- 
Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur, d’organisation et d’un excellent sens des priorités. 

- 
Doté(e) d’un fort esprit d’équipe, vous appréciez les environnements collaboratifs et transverses. 

- 
Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de plusieurs projets simultanément et savez évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique.

Ce Que Nous Vous Offrons : 

- 
Un environnement stimulant : Intégrez une agence reconnue mondialement, au cœur des stratégies de communication des plus grandes marques.

- 
Un encadrement de qualité : Vous serez accompagné(e) par des experts passionnés qui vous transmettront leur savoir-faire, avec des points réguliers et un feedback constructif pour vous aider à progresser.

- 
Une expérience professionnalisante : Développez des compétences clés et construisez une carrière solide dans un secteur en constante évolution.

- 
Une culture d’entreprise forte : Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et collaborative.

- 
Des avantages attractifs :

Télétravail possible (2 jours/semaine).

14 jours de RTT par an

Accès aux avantages du Comité d’Entreprise (cinéma, chèques cadeaux, remboursements sportifs…).

title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion. 

What you’ll do: 

- Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. 

- Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox. 

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers. 

- Perform code reviews and provide technical direction. 

- Work with a geographically-distributed development team. 

- Interact with teams throughout the organization. 

What you’ll bring: 

- 7+ years of overall software engineering experience. 

- Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++. 

- Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64. 

- Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS. 

- Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 

- Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset. 

- Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment. 

- Commitment to our values: 

- Welcoming differences 

- Being relationship-minded 

- Practicing responsible participation 

- Having grit 

Bonus Points for experience with: 

- Enterprise DLP development or deployment 

- Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. title: Account Executive, Portworx, FSI (EMEA)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure is seeking a Strategic Accounts Account Executive to accelerate growth of the Portworx platform across Strategic FSI accounts in EMEA. You will own a small number of named FSI customers and prospects, build and execute multi-year account plans, and drive platform adoption with a focus on business outcomes such as resilience, risk reduction, faster application delivery and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Everpure and Portworx, including Systems Engineering, Customer Experience, Marketing, Partner teams, Product and field leadership. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on strategic planning, disciplined execution and customer intimacy.

Location: Paris (preferred) or Staines, UK

What You’ll Do 

- Own and grow a portfolio of named Strategic FSI accounts, delivering against annual and multi-year revenue targets.

- Build and execute account plans that map buying centres, application priorities, Kubernetes roadmaps and transformation programmes.

- Develop executive relationships across CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE and Application leaders.

- Lead complex sales cycles from discovery through close, including security, risk, procurement, architecture review and legal processes.

- Position Portworx around measurable outcomes: application resilience, ransomware recovery, data protection, regulatory compliance, cloud portability and modernisation at scale.

- Orchestrate account teams and partner ecosystems, including GSIs, cloud providers and regional partners, to drive pipeline creation and deal execution.

- Run a rigorous, value-based sales process tailored to cloud native software, with accurate forecasting and strong hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting tools.

- Stay ahead of competitive dynamics in Kubernetes data services, backup and recovery, and container storage, using insights to sharpen strategy and messaging.

- Represent Portworx in customer meetings and relevant industry events, with a field-first mindset.

What You’ll Bring 

- Proven enterprise software sales or customer-facing solutions architecture experience, with a track record of winning and expanding high-value, multi-stakeholder deals in large organisations.

- Demonstrable experience selling into FSI, with an understanding of procurement, governance, risk and security requirements.

- Strong grasp of cloud native concepts and the Kubernetes ecosystem, such as OpenShift, Rancher or similar platforms, plus the ability to credibly engage architects and platform teams.

- Experience selling to both technical and executive stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into business value and risk outcomes.

- Disciplined pipeline generation, qualification, deal management and forecasting, with strong operational habits in Salesforce.

- Comfort working in a matrixed environment, influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

- Strong communication and programme management skills, with clear account planning and stakeholder alignment.

- A customer-first mindset and a bias for action, with resilience and curiosity.

- Fluent in French and English. Spanish would be a bonus.

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. The Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. In this role, you will focus on expanding our footprint across the French market, demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation to enterprise accounts.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 

- Manage an assigned territory focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities across the French market within mixed verticals

- Drive revenue growth by selling into Enterprise level accounts

- Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, and Transformation Teams throughout your sales cycles

Who You Are (Success Profile) 

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

- You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

- You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

- You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

- You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

- 5+ years of experience working with enterprise technology

- Proven track record of building new logos from scratch

- Direct experience navigating and selling within the French market

- Experience selling a complex SaaS solution and leading complex sales cycles

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 

- Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence tools or positioning AI-driven cloud security architectures to enterprise clients

- Bachelor degree

- Cyber security experience

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if… 

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if… 

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

- Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

- Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

- Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

- Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

- Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

- Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

- Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

- Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

- Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

- 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

- Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

- Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

- Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

- Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

- Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.

- Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

- Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting.

- Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products.

- Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components.

- Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills.

- Fluent English; German is a plus.

- Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

- Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability).

- Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes.

- Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials.

- Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR.

- Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge.

- Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD.

Benefits

- Equity + competitive salary.

- Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition.

- Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. 

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. 

Summary of Position: 

The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team. 

This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide. 

The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products. 

Position Responsibilities 

- Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives.

- Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe.

- Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations.

- Incorporate evidence gaps needed for European payers into evidence generation plans

- Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies.

- Serve as Europe HEOR partner to Europe Market Access for access and reimbursement dossiers by providing country-specific adaptations of models, methodology guidance, and scientific reviews that support country-level deliverables.

- Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses.

- Work closely across Global HEOR and cross-functional teams to inform endpoint, patient-reported outcome, and utility data collection strategy for clinical development programs so that trials generate evidence acceptable to payers and HTA bodies.

- Manage external HEOR vendors, budgets, and contracts, ensuring quality and timely delivery across competing priorities.

- Translate complex HEOR outputs and requirements into plain-language value narratives for internal leadership and external payers.

Candidate Requirements 

- Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services research, or another research-focused public health discipline

- 8+ years of HEOR experience with an MSc/MPH, or 5+ years with a PhD

- Extensive experience leading HEOR evidence generation to support HTA submissions across multiple markets in Europe

- Direct experience engaging with HTA organizations in Europe

- Working knowledge of EU HTA regulations and Joint Clinical Assessment process

- Experience developing or adapting budget-impact and cost-effectiveness models

- Experience conducted indirect treatment comparisons or network meta-analysis

- Strong track record of managing vendors

- Ability to influence cross-functional and regional stakeholders without direct authority

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Prior experience in neuromuscular disease and/or rare diseases is preferred but not required.

- ~15% travel, ability to work across global time zones

Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.

In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.

- Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).

- Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.

- Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup.

- Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems.

- Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues.

- Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date.

- Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves.

- Everything else that keeps us moving.

Your Skills and Experience 

- A degree in an ICT-related field (BSc level ideally), or an equivalent qualification such as Informatiker/in EFZ.

- At least one year of experience in a similar role in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong macOS knowledge and hands-on experience with JAMF (Pro).

- Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Intune; working knowledge of Windows.

- Familiarity with Okta or a similar identity provider (SSO, SCIM, MFA).

- Experience administering or supporting Slack and the Atlassian suite.

- Scripting experience (Bash, Zsh, Python or PowerShell) is a plus, and so is Linux experience.

- Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to solve problems creatively and proactively.

- Willingness to take on physical tasks such as desk moves and room setups.

- A strong drive to grow (at IMC we are committed to helping with that).

- You work autonomously, with a sense of urgency, and prioritize based on business needs.

- Available and willing to work on-site full-time in Zug.

- Proficient in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

About Us 

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description:
About us: 

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

- Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

- Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

- Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

- Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

- Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

- Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you: 

- Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

- Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

- Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

- Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

- Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms

- Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale

- Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team

- Take ownership and can work independently when needed

- Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have)

What you can look forward to: 

- Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

- Collaborative and supportive work environment

- Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

- Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Engineering Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 

80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Über MaxBrain

MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.

Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.

Worum es geht

Als Engineering Lead übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für MaxBrain. Du führst unser Entwicklungsteam über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg und bist dabei selbst technisch nah dran – du gibst Architektur, Qualität und Tempo vor. Gemeinsam mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead trägst du die Umsetzungsverantwortung für die Roadmap und stellst sicher, dass die Plattform verlässlich und in hoher Qualität betrieben und weiterentwickelt wird.

Eine zentrale Rolle spielt das Shaping unserer AI-Capabilities: KI ist dabei fest in die ganze Plattform eingebaut, nicht nur in einzelne Funktionen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.

Deine Aufgaben

- Technische Führung: Du leitest und entwickelst ein kleines aber erfahrenes Entwicklungsteam von SysAdmin, DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile und schaffst eine Kultur von Ownership, Qualität und Tempo.

- Lieferverantwortung für die Roadmap: In enger Abstimmung mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead sorgst du dafür, dass die Roadmap verlässlich, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität ausgeliefert wird.

- AI-Capabilities weiterentwickeln: Du prägst, wie KI unser Lern Ökosystem spürbar wirksamer macht – ganz im Sinne von «Make Learning Matter». Du führst die KI Transformation in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb der Plattform, um diese neue Technologie gewinnbringend für MaxBrain einzusetzen.

- Technische Projektleitung: Du berätst unsere Kunden und unser Customer Success Team zu Themen wie Integrationen und Automatisierungen und verantwortest entsprechende Projekte von A bis Z aus technischer Sicht.

- Architektur und technische Exzellenz: Du gestaltest die Architektur zusammen mit den Entwicklern, triffst fundierte Technologieentscheidungen und hältst Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit hoch.

- CISO/ISO-27001: Du betreust die jährliche ISO-Rezertifizierung und verantwortest den Bereich Datensicherheit für MaxBrain.

Dein Profil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Entwicklungsteams, idealerweise über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg, kombiniert mit eigener technischer Exzellenz.

- Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer B2B-SaaS-Architekturen, inklusive Schnittstellen, Integrationen und Automatisierungen für anspruchsvolle Grosskunden.

- Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen KI-/ML-Technologien und Freude daran, KI-Capabilities von der Idee bis in die Produktion zu bringen.

- Du denkst in Lieferverantwortung: Du priorisiert pragmatisch, triffst klare Architekturentscheidungen und bringst Releases verlässlich und in hoher Qualität auf die Strasse.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und Business zusammen und übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse in tragfähige technische Lösungen.

- Du bist vertraut mit Symfony/PHP, Go, Angular, MySQL und Docker/Kubernetes. Du findest es spannend, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und verstehst es, sie gewinnbringend einzusetzen.

- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1-C2); unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

- Eine Kultur, die lebt, was wir verkaufen: Wir lernen selbst jeden Tag dazu, teilen Wissen offen und nehmen «Make Learning Matter» auch intern ernst.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

- Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.

- Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.

- Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.

- Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.

- Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.

- Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.

- Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.

- Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

- A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.

- A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.

- Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.

- Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.

- Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

- First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.

- Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.

- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.

- Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.

- Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.

- Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

- Flexibility and ownership

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Our agentic AI platform helps enterprises worldwide remove manual execution from their core business processes, enabling those processes to run autonomously end-to-end, with greater control and productivity gains of 5–10×.

Today, more than 550 enterprise customers rely on BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. Across more than 40 countries, our platform automates purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes for organizations ranging from mid-sized companies to Fortune 500 enterprises with complex global operations.

Our success is built on deep expertise in business processes and technology, a differentiated product, and strong product-market fit, as reflected in a continually expanding customer base.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role 

- What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

- Where you'll work. You join the Product Core Team, about 12 engineers. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns, and with the frontend engineers who build the UIs on top of your APIs.

- What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do 

- Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

- Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

- Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

- Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including their audit trail.

- Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and the APIs behind our admin UIs, so customers and project managers can run them on their own.

- Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

- Own it end-to-end. From design through the Go service to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because 

- You have 4+ years of experience as a backend developer , building and operating systems in production.

- You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects.

- You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

- You work well across teams. You align with product, frontend, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

- You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

- You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

- You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus 

- Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

- Experience running multi-tenant systems.

- Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get 

- Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

- Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

- Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

- Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

- Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

- Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

- Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

- 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

- Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

- Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

- You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

- You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

- You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

- You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

- You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

- You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

- Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

- Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

- Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

- Working knowledge of ClickHouse, or another columnar / OLAP engine

Perks 

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
