title: Cloud Architect
description:
About Vitestro 

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. 

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro 

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like: 

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities: 

- Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

- Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

- Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

- Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

- Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

- Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

- Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

- Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces

What You’ll Bring: 

- Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

- Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

- Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

- A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

- Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

- Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

- Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

- Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have: 

- Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

- Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

- Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

- Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work 

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

- We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

- We focus on execution and delivering results.

- We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

- We challenge ideas, not people.

- We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

- We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

- Competitive salary including a pension plan

- 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

- A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

- Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

- A training budget

- The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. - Founder Mentality & Ownership: An entrepreneurial instinct. You operate like an owner, thrive in ambiguity, and take ideas from 0 to 1 without needing a predetermined playbook.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
The challenge 
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.

These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.

What you’ll do 

- Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

- Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

- Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

- Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

- Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

- AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

- Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

The Team 

You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.

What you’ll bring 

- 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

- A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

- Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

- Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

- Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

- Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

- Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

- Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.

Who you are 

- Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

- Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

- Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

- Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

- Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

- Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

- You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.

Recruitment process 

- First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

- Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

- Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

- Meet the CEO. 

- Reference check 

- Offer 

What You Get 

Competitive compensation 

- 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth 

- €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

- 25 vacation days 

- Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

- Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere 

- As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you’ll actually want to be part of 

- Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

- Regular team moments and outings 

- An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

- Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

- Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact 

- A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. 

About Talk360 

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. 

Here’s what our users say: 

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ 

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★ 

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs
description:
In de non-profit-, overheid- en onderwijswereld draait alles om impact en vertrouwen. Het proces is gestructureerd en verloopt stap voor stap, maar tenders zijn complex en relaties zijn cruciaal. Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt. 

Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Ze sturen standaardproposities en hopen op het beste. Wij geloven dat het anders moet: met echte gesprekken, diep begrip van aanbestedingsdynamiek en een adviseur die meedenkt in het PvE-proces in plaats van alleen reageert op een uitvraag. 

Daarom bestaat deze rol. Jij bent onderdeel van het team aan tenderspecialisten die marktpartijen begeleidt van marktconsultatie tot tender tot win — en die daarna zorgt dat het contract goed landt.

Jouw rol 

Je bouwt een sterke pijplijn van tenders en RFPs bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten, onderwijsinstellingen en enterprise-accounts. Je wint aanbestedingen en zorgt dat Studytube vanaf de marktconsultatie al als thought leader op de radar staat.

Concreet ga je aan de slag met: 

- Het vroegtijdig spotten van marktconsultaties (ism het Tenderteam) en het actief meedenken in het PvE-proces, zodat criteria aansluiten bij wat wij goed kunnen leveren. 

- Thought leadership richting inkopers en beleidsmakers, zodat Studytube al vóór de formele tender een bekende en vertrouwde naam is. 

- Het volledige tendertraject managen: van marktconsultatie, via inschrijving en EMVI-onderbouwing, tot gunning en win. 

- RFPs bij grotere enterprise-klanten samen met andere Account Executives voorbereiden en oppakken, zodat expertise en capaciteit gebundeld worden. 

- Het zorgvuldig managen van het contractproces na gunning, inclusief afstemming met legal over voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en SLA's. 

- Het opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met opleidingsmanagers, inkopers en directieleden bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen. 

- Het samenwerken met sales team, tenderteam, implementatieteam, contentteam en customer success team om klanten écht succesvol te maken. 

What the job looks like 

Geen strak jaarplan, maar een dynamische agenda die meebeweegt met de tenderkalender. De ene week werk je aan een marktconsultatie, de volgende week schrijf je aan een inschrijving, ondersteun je een collega-AE bij een enterprise-RFP, of onderhandel je over een contract.

Dagelijks ziet het er ongeveer zo uit: 

- Je volgt tenderplatforms en de markt scherp en identificeert kansen al in de marktconsultatiefase. 

- Je bouwt offertes en proposities die aansluiten bij EMVI-criteria en publieke waarden. 

- Je beoordeelt en onderhandelt contractvoorwaarden, en schakelt waar nodig met legal. 

- Je werkt samen met andere Account Executives aan RFPs voor grotere enterprise-klanten. 

- Je werkt samen met interne teams zodat de klant de beste ervaring krijgt – van tender tot implementatie. 

- Je monitort je pijplijn, stuurt bij en zorgt dat je targets realistisch maar ambitieus zijn. 

Who you are 

We zoeken geen standaard salesprofiel. We zoeken iemand die tenders en RFPs als vakgebied ziet, niet als bijzaak. 

Wat wél belangrijk is: 

- Je hebt 4 tot 6 jaar ervaring in sales, bij voorkeur met tenders/RFPs in non-profit, overheid of onderwijs. 

- Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van marktconsultaties en het beïnvloeden van een PvE. 

- Je hebt affiniteit met contracten en legal processen — je bent niet bang voor voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en onderhandelingen (pre). 

- Je bent een consultative seller: je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en geeft oprecht advies. 

- Je bent relationeel sterk en bouwt liever langdurige partnerships dan snelle deals. 

- Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende teams, ook binnen een enterprise-RFP waar je met andere AEs optrekt. 

- Je schrijft en spreekt goed Nederlands (C1-niveau) en voelt de nuance van formele communicatie in aanbestedingstrajecten. 

What we offer

- €1.000 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar + onbeperkt toegang tot de Studytube Academy

- MacBook, telefoonvergoeding en dagelijks verzorgde lunch 

- Een team dat écht gelooft in wat we doen en waarin je snel impact kunt maken 

Over Studytube 

Wij maken professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk, leuk en effectief. Met meer dan 300 klanten, waaronder veel non-profitorganisaties en bekende namen als Bol.com, ASR en Ajax, groeien we hard. Ons doel is duidelijk: Europa's beste platform voor leren en ontwikkelen worden.

Solliciteren? 
Dat kan via de button op de website. Om een goed te kunnen beoordelen of een stage bij de Volkskrant bij je past, vragen we je om het volgende aan te leveren: 

- Curriculum vitae 

- Motivatiebrief 

- Drie Nederlandstalige artikelen of producties van jouw hand. De artikelen of producties hoeven niet daadwerkelijk gepubliceerd te zijn. Voeg deze artikelen integraal of via een url toe onderaan je motivatiebrief. 

- Vergeet niet te vermelden op welke redacties je zou willen werken en in welke periode. 

We bieden stages aan op de volgende deelredacties: 

- Binnenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het nieuws uit Nederland. 

- Politieke redactie (in Den Haag): je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten en debatverslagen over de landelijke politiek. 

- Buitenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, interviews, profielen of korte analyses over het nieuws uit andere landen. 

- Economie: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het economisch nieuws uit binnen- en buitenland. 

- Wetenschap: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, analyses of interviews over het nieuws uit de wetenschappelijke wereld. 

- Data-, osint- en onderzoeksjournalistiek: je schrijft artikelen op basis van data of andere openbare bronnen of werkt mee aan langlopende onderzoeken. 

- V (kunst, cultuur en media): je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de culturele wereld in binnen- en buitenland. 

- Sport: je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de sportwereld. 

- Visuele redactie: je helpt en denkt mee aan de productie van onderscheidende online verhalen, waarbij tekst samengaat met foto, video en andere verhaalelementen. 

- Video, audio en event: je helpt en denkt mee bij de productie van onze podcasts, video’s en bij de organisatie van live-evenementen van de Volkskrant. 

- Foto / beeldredactie: je helpt en denkt mee bij de keuze van foto’s bij onze nieuwsartikelen en andere verhalen. 

- Digitaal team: je helpt en denkt mee bij de verspreiding van onze artikelen via de mobiele app, website, nieuwsbrieven en pushberichten. 

Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat? 

- Je bent nieuwsgierig, hebt journalistieke ambitie en affiniteit met de Volkskrant. 

- Voor de verslaggevende redacties: je hebt schrijftalent en -ervaring. 

- Je bent gewend om zelfstandig te werken. 

- Je bent minimaal drie maanden fulltime beschikbaar. Een vierdaagse werkweek is bespreekbaar. 

We hebben een voorkeur voor studenten van een hbo-opleiding of een master journalistiek, maar ook anderen zijn van harte welkom om te solliciteren. De Volkskrant streeft een diverse redactie na: we nodigen stagiairs met een biculturele achtergrond nadrukkelijk uit werkervaring bij ons op te doen.

Wat bieden wij? 

- Een leuke en leerzame periode bij de grootste kwaliteitskrant van Nederland. 

- Intensieve begeleiding door je chef en ervaren redacteuren. 

- De stage duurt in principe drie maanden. Een verlenging is tijdens je stage bespreekbaar. 

- Een stagevergoeding van 400 euro per maand (exclusief een reiskostenvergoeding). 

- Een abonnement op de Volkskrant gedurende je stageperiode. 

Vragen?
Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met stagecoördinator Pepijn de Lange via het e-mailadres .

title: Data Scientist Total Video
description:
Amsterdam or Antwerp - Combine Data Science, AI, and Media to transform the advertising market. As a Data Scientist Total Video, you will take the lead in integrating TV advertising and digital video advertising into a scalable Total Video advertising product. If you are looking for a high-impact role where you can build an innovative data product from the ground up, this is your call. 

What will you do?
As a Data Scientist Total Video, you develop data products at the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and AI to enable Total Video at scale. You provide the crucial holistic data focus needed to successfully integrate the worlds of TV advertising and online video advertising. With your expertise, you translate complex business challenges into concrete data solutions and contribute directly to the further development of an innovative product, that will transform the advertising market. You do this by: 

• Analyzing complex datasets and translating stakeholder challenges into concrete solutions, that you continuously improve iteratively
• Developing and implementing scalable data products and models within a production environment
• Collaborating within a dedicated development and product team on the realization of Total Video for the Belgian and Dutch markets
• Working closely with Ad Alliance in the Netherlands and DPG Media Advertising in Belgium 

Who are we?
We are the Total Video team, part of the Advertising Ecosystem & Strategy domain. In the coming years, we are investing heavily in the development of Total Video: a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up that will change the advertising market. The team is currently being built and consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in business, data, product, and technology. 

What makes you the ideal candidate?
For this role, we are looking for a person that is able to create and build things from scratch. Is optimistic, committed, driven, and creative. In addition, you bring: 

• 5+ years experience in a similar role 
• Deep expertise in data science and machine learning, enabling you to design, train, and implement models in production environments
• Experience transforming data models into scalable data products, preferably within a media or advertising environment
• Strong analytical and conceptual skills, allowing you to recognize patterns in complex datasets and translate them into concrete solutions
• Experience with machine learning tools and MLOps systems such as Docker, Databricks, and MLflow
• Strong communication skills to clearly convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we encourage you to apply for this role. It is precisely the differences between colleagues that lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions. And that fits perfectly with who we are as an organization. We are curious to learn more about you and the qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment? Click here ! 

What do we offer?
You will join an inspiring work environment that is constantly evolving. You will work with colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities, and encourage you to continue developing yourself every day. We support this through our DPG Academy, giving you every opportunity to get the best out of yourself and grow as a true media maker. 

💰 A salary that matches your experience
📝 A 36/38 hour working week
💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget
💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media’s performance
🎓 Plenty of opportunities for development, both on the job and online through our DPG Academy
🎉 Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays
🏢 A fantastic office. From spontaneous drinks to team outings and our legendary staff party, you will quickly feel at home here! 

Even more reasons to join DPG Media
At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 strong news brands, magazines, television programs, radio stations, and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl , Tweakers, Libelle, VTM, and more. Every month, we reach over 90% of the Dutch population and 8 out of 10 Flemish people. We offer a professional work environment where freedom and ownership are highly valued. You will have every opportunity to work on your future through workshops and training programs. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player, and above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 talented colleagues are ready to welcome you into a team, whether it is a project team, a pub quiz team, or a sports team. 

Discover what we have to offer you. And while you are at it, you can also find us on Instagram , LinkedIn and X . 

Applying, and then?
Ready to get started? Apply directly! You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days. If you are selected for the first round, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our Amsterdam or Antwerp office.

Wat ga je doen als Product Owner Digital Customer Platform?
Als Product Owner Digital Customer Platform ben je verantwoordelijk voor één van de belangrijkste platformteams binnen Independer. Je geeft richting aan het digitale fundament van Mijn Independer 2.0 en vertaalt complexe technische vraagstukken naar een heldere productvisie, duidelijke prioriteiten en concrete resultaten. Met jouw werk maak je veilige, betrouwbare en schaalbare klantinteracties mogelijk en creëer je de basis voor personalisatie, AI-oplossingen en toekomstige digitale dienstverlening. Zonder deze rol ontbreekt de technische basis waarop nieuwe klantfunctionaliteiten gebouwd worden.

Team

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner 

Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder! 

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door: 

- Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten. 

- Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken. 

- Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking. 

- De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web. 

- Verzoeken van DPG Media, sales en andere interne stakeholders te analyseren, samen te werken met de UX'er en data-analist aan de juiste KPI's en meetpunten en advies te geven over prioritering. 

Wie zijn wij? 

Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. Onze website en apps ontvangen wij maandelijks 875000 unieke gebruikers en onze ambitie reikt verder. We bevinden ons midden in een transformatie waarin de digitale folder volledig wordt vernieuwd en het platform opnieuw wordt opgebouwd. 

Reclamefolder.nl heeft een ondernemende cultuur met ongeveer 25 collega's binnen IT, marketing en sales. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van DPG Media, opereren we zelfstandig. Hierdoor heb je veel invloed op de productontwikkeling en bedrijfsvoering, terwijl je tegelijkertijd profiteert van de kennis en expertise van een grote mediaorganisatie. 

Je werkt in een multidisciplinair productteam bestaande uit een Product Manager, webdeveloper, iOS-developer, Android-developer, backenddevelopers, een UX'er, een data-analist en een Tech Lead. In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden. 

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

- 2 jaar ervaring als Product Owner 

- Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en ervaring met het werken in multidisciplinaire productteams. 

- Ervaring met het zelfstandig uitwerken van backlog-items voor een digitaal product en samenwerking met developers, bijvoorbeeld als Product Owner, Business Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol. 

- Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt. 

- Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt. 

Pré 

- Ervaring met digitale producten die beschikbaar zijn op iOS, Android en web. 

- Ervaring binnen retail media, advertising, e-commerce of marketplaces. 

- Basiskennis van tracking en analytics, zoals events, funnels en dashboards. 

- Ervaring met het opstellen van een meetplan voor nieuwe features. 

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier! 

Wat krijg je van ons? 

Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn! 

- 💰 Een salaris passend bij jouw werkervaring

title: Backend Engineer, GenAI Platform
description:
Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! 

What will you do? 

As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. 

- Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. 

- Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. 

- Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. 

Who are we? 

We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. 

What makes you the ideal candidate? 

For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. 

- Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. 

- Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. 

- Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. 

- Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. 

Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. 

How do you work? 

You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. 

Our stack 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. 

- Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. 

- Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. 

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions. 

At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here! 

What do we offer? 

At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. You will collaborate with colleagues who think in possibilities and you will have every opportunity to continue developing yourself through your work and the DPG Academy. 

li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100">- 💰 A competitive salary based on your work experience. 

- 📝 A 36-hour work week in the Netherlands or a 38-hour work week in Belgium. 

- 💰 8% holiday allowance and 4% personal choice budget. 

- 💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media's performance. 

- 🎓 Opportunities to develop yourself both on the job and through the DPG Academy / DPG Campus. 

- 🎉 The possibility to personalise your cultural public holidays. 

- 🏢 Hybrid working, with office days agreed together with your team. 

Even more reasons to join DPG Media 

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 leading news brands, magazines, television programmes, radio stations and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM and many more. Every month we reach more than 90% of people in the Netherlands and 8 out of 10 people in Flanders. We offer a professional working environment where freedom and personal development are highly valued. Through workshops and training, you are given every opportunity to invest in your future. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player and, above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media. 

Discover everything we have to offer. And while you're at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X. 

Applying, what's next? 

Are you ready to get started? Apply directly. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days and hear whether you have been selected for the first interview. The recruitment process consists of:

title: Teamleider Inbound
description:
Stuur jij ons inbound-team aan en zorg je dat elke zending binnen no-time op de juiste plek ligt?

Krijg jij energie van een strak georganiseerd magazijn? Bij All4running draait alles om snelheid en nauwkeurigheid. Wij zoeken een meewerkend voorman/vrouw die de volledige controle neemt over onze goederenontvangst. Als Teamleider Inbound zorg jij dat de voorraad altijd klopt en dat jouw team elke dag met plezier de targets haalt.

Wat ga je doen?

In deze rol ben je het aanspreekpunt op de vloer voor de goederenontvangst. Je rapporteert aan onze Warehouse Manager en werkt nauw samen met je collega-Teamleiders van Outbound en Retouren om de dagelijkse operatie soepel te laten verlopen.

• Aansturing op de vloer: Je coacht, motiveert en begeleidt jouw team van 4 tot 8 medewerkers. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig en werkt waar nodig mee.

• WMS-beheer (Picqer): Je zorgt voor een foutloze inslag. Je ziet toe op een strikte scan-discipline en lost administratieve verschillen in het systeem direct op.

• Planning & Forecast: Je maakt de personeelsplanning (via Dyflexis), waarbij je 4 tot 6 weken vooruitkijkt om drukke periodes op te vangen.

• Procesbewaking: Je schakelt snel met de afdeling Inkoop en zorgt dat de fysieke binnenkomst van orders naadloos aansluit op de administratieve afhandeling.

Wie zoeken wij? 

Wij zoeken een praktische leider die van aanpakken weet, rust brengt in de hectiek en het overzicht bewaart tussen de stellingen.

• Ervaring: Je hebt ervaring in een logistieke omgeving en bent toe aan een tweede stap in je carrière of je hebt al ervaring als (assistent) teamleider.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in Germany. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions with a primary focus on Germany and support for the DACH region, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities 

- Draft, review, and negotiate enterprise commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in Germany, with support for EMEA as a whole, as a member of a growing commercial legal team in the regions.

- Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

- Monitor and interpret evolving country specific legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

- Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect local requirements and industry best practices.

- Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

- Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are 

- Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

- Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

- Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

- Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

- Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring 

- Law degree and qualification to practice law in Germany.

- Native-level German and fluent English.

- 7+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

- Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.

- Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

- Experience advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border data transfer issues.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

- Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

Location 

This role is remote, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany.

Build a finance function that scales through better systems, not a bigger team.

Junior Data Scientist 

Berlin, On-site 

Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day.

description:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll: 

- Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

- Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

- Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Senior Growth Manager (Berlin) 

Salary Range: €65k-€90k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. This is a full 360 degree role with a sales and account management motion. Quota chasing is not the job but you'll have full top-line ownership and will not only shape the work but also execute it.

What You’ll Do 🎯

- Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

- Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

- Run the ROAS dial. Tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Translate cap-fill outcomes and retention targets into bid moves. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

- Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

- Translate between commercial and technical teams . When a partner reports cost-data drift, you debug, push our engineering teams for an ETA, and frame the response back to the partner.

- Ship the playbook. Document improvements to the Growth team's standard operating procedures every week.

What your first 90 days look like

- Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine.

- Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our Director or CEO. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

- Days 61–90: Senior team treats you as the named owner. You're already covering for a peer's vacation. You've spotted at least one non-obvious revenue lever on your book.

- Beyond 90 days: Within a few years, the path runs from regional accounts to country ownership to multi-country or vertical leadership (gaming, non-gaming) to regional head (EMEA) or global.

What You’ll Bring 💡

- You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not just collect a title.

- You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. A 15% cohort revenue drop on a daily view? You spot it in under 30 seconds and you explain it in two sentences a non-technical listener gets.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
description:
About the team: 

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

What you’ll do: 

- Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.

- Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.

- Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.

- Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.

- Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

- Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

You’ll be great for this role if you have: 

- Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.

- Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.

- A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.

- A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.

- A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.

- Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.

- Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

Why you should join SumUp: 

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks .

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. 

About us: 

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Job Application Tip 

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Over 40,000 buyers. More than 20 countries. Every vehicle listed, sold and settled through one platform. On our Inventory team you own the Service and Sales Cloud layer that carries those transactions: Apex, LWC, Platform Events, and the two-way integration that keeps Salesforce and our core system in step.

Location: Central Berlin. You work on site in our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days remote.

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform, and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer, as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine. 

Your responsibilities

- You build and customise Service Cloud and Sales Cloud solutions that carry our dealer and buyer processes end to end

- You own Apex classes, Lightning Web Components and Visualforce pages across the Inventory team's scope

- You design and maintain the two-way integration between Salesforce and our core platform (REST APIs, Platform Events, event-driven flows)

- You decide where standard configuration is enough (Flows, metadata, permission sets) and where custom development earns its place

- You design data models and API integrations that keep transaction data consistent between Salesforce and our backend systems

- You take ownership of underused platform features and reduce technical debt in the existing codebase

- You secure reliability and performance through monitoring, release management and clean deployment practice

- You work in agile sprints and shape the architecture decisions behind them

What you bring

- 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, with Service Cloud and Sales Cloud in production

- Deep command of Apex, LWC, Aura, Visualforce, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS

- Strong relational data modelling with SOQL and SQL

- Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and Salesforce integration patterns (REST APIs, Platform Events)

- Clear judgement on standard platform configuration versus custom development

- Comfortable in release management and scrum frameworks, and able to carry a technical argument in a business conversation

- English at C1 level, written and spoken

- AI-fluent working style. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your day-to-day

Nice to have 

- Salesforce certifications, particularly Platform Developer I or II, or Service Cloud Consultant

- German at B2 level

- Experience mentoring other developers and reviewing their work

What you can expect from us

- Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

- 28 days annual leave

- 2× annual career & development conversations

- Company pension with 20% employer contribution

- Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)

- FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy

- Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work

- Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events

- Lived diversity: active women's network, meditation & prayer room

Apply now — your CV is enough.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Berlin team. In this role, you’ll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact. 

We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation 

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers. 

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not. 

What you’ll be doing 

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations 

- 5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.

- Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.

- Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.

- Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.

- Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.

- Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.

- Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.

What we offer 

- The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.

- You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙 

- You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.

Next steps 

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via -----

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description:
About commercetools 

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact 

Hello! I'm Roberto Olmeda, leading the Search Discovery Team at commercetools. Search is fundamentally changing shape. Shoppers are moving from keywords to full sentences—and increasingly, the client querying our APIs isn’t a human at all, it’s an AI agent. My team builds the core retrieval layer behind product discovery for the world’s most demanding commerce brands. As we take semantic and hybrid search to general availability, we’re tackling hard engineering problems at every layer: from query understanding and vector indexing down to latency, measurable relevance, and the cost of a single query. We’re looking for a Senior Search Engineer to build across Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and our functional Scala backend—whether you already love functional programming or are excited to master it with us. 

You will: 

- Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend

- Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval

- Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB

- Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it

- Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture

- Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps

- Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools

- Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart 

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

- At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM

- Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O

- Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover

- Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.

- Fluent English for work in international teams

- Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s

- Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics

- A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

- Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents

- Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.

- Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals

- Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

Our Benefits 

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success 

For more information on our benefits, visit this page. 

Come as you are. Build with us. 

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

description:
The role 

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities 

Build and ship 

- Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production

- Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation

- Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call

- Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction 

- Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured

- Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit

- Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design 

- Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity

- Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin

- Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works 

- Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working 

- Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes

- Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise 

AI-native engineering 

- Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace

- Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows

- Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release

- Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails

- Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders

- Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations 

- Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating

- Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)

- Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores

- Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry

- Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building 

- Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop

- Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills 

- Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements

- Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets

- Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value

- Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer

- Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person

- Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated

Our Offer 

- 
Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- 
Flexi-office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.

- 
Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.

- 
Health and Wellbeing : With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.

- 
Development : We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.

- 
Appreciation : Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.

We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/ en / , and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why
