title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Portfolio, Wachstums-Roadmap und Go-to-Market für Cloud-, Daten-, KI- und SaaS-Lösungen – du machst Marketing und Vertrieb im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand noch erfolgreicher.

Über Coduct Group 

Die Coduct-Gruppe verbindet Technologieberatung, Umsetzung und eigene Produkte unter einem Dach. Seit 2017 begleiten wir Unternehmen bei der Modernisierung ihrer IT-Systeme, Plattformen und Cloud-Architekturen – von der Analyse über Entwicklung und Migration bis zum Betrieb. 

- Die Marke Coduct (Kamp-Lintfort, Berlin, Ho-Chi-Minh-City): IT-Beratung und Softwareentwicklung für Cloud, Daten, KI und Automatisierung; auch als Build-Operate-Transfer-Modell (BOT) 

- Die Marke ainavio : unsere SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement (PIM) 

- Die Marke Code Leap : unsere Software-Engineering-Marke 

Als Microsoft CSP-Partner und dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI, Digital & App Innovation, Infrastructure/Azure) kombinieren wir Lizenzierung, Beratung und Umsetzung aus einer Hand. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Energieversorger, ERP- und Softwareanbieter, Handel und E-Commerce sowie Industrieunternehmen – darunter JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria. 

Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt besetzen 

Wir stehen an der Schwelle zur nächsten Wachstumsphase. Dafür haben wir die Unternehmensfunktion Growth geschaffen, geführt von unserem VP Growth. Growth plant das Wachstum der Gruppe und sorgt dafür, dass es gelingt: Wir entwickeln Portfolio und Wachstums-Roadmap und befähigen Marketing und Vertrieb, Wachstum zu realisieren. 

Wichtig: Growth ist kein zweiter Vertrieb – aber Growth jagt. Nach dem Hunting-Prinzip spürst du Wachstumschancen aktiv auf und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Kundenbeziehungen liegen beim Vertrieb; du sorgst dafür, dass er die richtigen Angebote, Argumente und Werkzeuge hat – und dass aus ersten Aufträgen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen werden. 

Deine Aufgaben 

1. Wachstumsstrategie & Growth-Roadmap 

- Du entwickelst mit dem VP Growth eine mehrjährige Growth-Roadmap mit klaren Etappen, Prioritäten und Meilensteinen 

- Du jagst aktiv Wachstumschancen – neue Segmente, Partnerschaften (u. a. Microsoft), Großchancen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss 

- Du bewertest Zielsegmente und validierst neue Geschäftsfelder schnell und pragmatisch 

- Du übersetzt die Roadmap in konkrete Initiativen, Business Cases und gemeinsame Ziele mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery 

2. Portfolio-Entwicklung (Kern der Rolle) 

- Du gestaltest unsere Portfolio-Architektur mit einer ausgewogenen Balance aus Volumen- bzw. Standardangeboten (z. B. CSP, Managed Services, SaaS, Festpreis-Pakete) und Premium- bzw. Individualleistungen (z. B. Beratung, Custom Development, BOT, End-to-End-Transformation) 

- Du produktisierst wiederkehrende Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten – und schärfst gleichzeitig die Differenzierung unserer Premiumleistungen 

- Du verantwortest Positionierung (Problem – Lösung – Nutzen), Pricing-Logik und Lifecycle der Angebote, gemeinsam mit Delivery und Technologie 

3. Land-and-Expand-Modell 

- Du entwickelst Einstiegsangebote, mit denen neue Kunden einfach starten können (Land), und klare Ausbaupfade hin zu Folgeprojekten, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS (Expand) 

- Du baust Programme für die Entwicklung unserer Bestandskunden auf – z. B. vom reinen Lizenzbezug zu Cloud-, Daten- und KI-Services – und gibst dem Vertrieb dafür Anlässe, Zielkundenlisten und Werkzeuge an die Hand 

4. Enablement von Marketing & Vertrieb 

- Du befähigst den Vertrieb mit Playbooks, Pitch- und Angebotsvorlagen, Argumentationshilfen, Pricing-Rechnern und Schulungen 

- Du entwickelst mit Marketing Zielgruppen, Ideal Customer Profiles, Messaging und Kampagnen und sorgst für eine konsistente Story: Was machen wir, für wen, und warum Coduct? 

- Du unterstützt bei strategisch wichtigen Angeboten mit Angebotsstruktur und Pricing – die Kundenverantwortung bleibt beim Vertrieb 

5. Growth-Prozesse & Steuerung 

- Du gestaltest das Growth Operating Model: Prozesse und Übergaben von Marketing über Vertrieb bis Delivery, klare Rollen und CRM-Standards 

- Du baust ein KPI-System auf – von Pipeline und Conversion über Expansion-Umsatz und Net Revenue Retention bis zum Anteil standardisierter und wiederkehrender Umsätze und zum Margen-Mix 

- Du steuerst Initiativen datenbasiert und machst Learnings teamübergreifend nutzbar 

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen 

- Umsatzbeitrag neuer und überarbeiteter Angebote 

- Expansion bei Bestandskunden (z. B. Cross-Sell-Quote, Net Revenue Retention) 

- Ausgewogener Portfolio-Mix: Anteil standardisierter/wiederkehrender Umsätze bei gesunder Marge im Premiumgeschäft 

- Wirksamkeit des Enablements: Nutzung durch den Vertrieb, Conversion und Time-to-Sale neuer Angebote 

- Umsetzung der Growth-Roadmap nach Plan 

Diese Ziele bilden – zusammen mit der Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT der Gruppe – die Grundlage deiner variablen Vergütung. 

Was du mitbringst 

Erfahrung & Know-how 

- Mindestens 5 Jahre im B2B-Umfeld in Portfolio- oder Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development – idealerweise in IT-Services, Cloud, Software oder Beratung 

- Portfolio-Management: Du hast Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert, bepreist und erfolgreich in den Markt gebracht 

- Land and Expand: Du hast Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade gestaltet und kennst die Hebel für Wachstum im Bestand 

- Balance von Volumen und Premium: Du verstehst, wie sich Standard- und Individualgeschäft in Preis, Marge, Delivery und Vertrieb unterscheiden – und wie beide sich verstärken 

- Strategische Kompetenz: Du entwickelst Roadmaps, setzt Prioritäten und übersetzt Strategie in messbare Ergebnisse 

- Vertriebserfahrung: Du kennst Vertrieb aus eigener Praxis (z. B. Vertrieb, Pre-Sales, Key Account) und weißt, was Vertriebsteams wirklich hilft 

- Mittelstand, DACH, SaaS und CSP: Du kennst Bedürfnisse und Entscheidungswege mittelständischer Unternehmen, den DACH-Markt sowie SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Geschäftsmodelle 

- Prozessmanagement & Vertriebscontrolling: Du gestaltest Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg, arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPIs 

- Sprachen: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch 

Persönlichkeit & Arbeitsweise 

- Hunter-Mentalität: Du jagst neue Wachstumschancen – Segmente, Partnerschaften, Großchancen – und bringst sie mit Marketing und Vertrieb zum Abschluss 

- Ergebnisorientierung: Du willst dich an messbaren Zielen und an deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT messen lassen – auch in der Vergütung 

- Macher:in: Du handelst proaktiv, mit Bias for Action, und lieferst Ergebnisse statt Konzepte für die Schublade 

- Einfluss ohne Weisungsbefugnis: Du überzeugst Vertrieb, Marketing, Delivery und Geschäftsführung – mit Klarheit, Daten und guten Argumenten 

- Teamplayer in verteilten Teams: Du machst andere erfolgreich, teilst Wissen offen und arbeitest gern remote, asynchron und mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Vietnam 

- Ambition zu wachsen: Du willst in den nächsten Jahren mehr strategische und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen 

Wünschenswert 

- Erfahrung im Microsoft-Partner-Ökosystem (Co-Selling, Partnerprogramme, Marketplace) 

- Erfahrung mit Sales- oder Revenue-Operations und Enablement-Programmen 

- Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools in Analyse, Content und Enablement 

Was wir dir bieten 

- Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die Growth-Funktion von Anfang an mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit VP Growth und Geschäftsführung zusammen 

- Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus variable Komponente – dein Erfolg bei Growth-KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT zahlt sich direkt aus 

- Entwicklungspfad: Die Rolle ist bewusst als Sprungbrett angelegt – hin zu einer führenden Growth-Rolle in der Gruppe 

- Zukunftsthemen: Cloud, Daten, KI und eigene SaaS-Produkte – mit eigenem Delivery-Center in Vietnam 

- Kultur: ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und kurze Wege hat 

- Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region 

So läuft der Auswahlprozess 

- Sichtung deiner Unterlagen – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 10 Werktagen 

- Erstgespräch (ca. 75 Minuten, per Video) mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing 

- Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch (ca. 90 Min., per Video) mit der Geschäftsführung – du präsentierst deine Lösung einer praxisnahen Aufgabe (ca. 1 Woche Vorbereitung)

- Angebot 

Interesse? 

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beantworte uns kurz eine Frage: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so entwickelt oder geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat – und wie hast du den Vertrieb dabei mitgenommen? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Starttermin nennst du uns gern direkt mit. 

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Google Ads
description:
Unser Partner ist eine etablierte D2C-Lifestyle-Brand für Food & Beverage-Produkte. Die Marke verbindet exzellentes Design mit nachhaltigem Genuss und bietet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit enormem Wachstumspotenzial.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du steuerst, optimierst und entwickelst unsere Kampagnen mit Fokus auf Google Ads & Meta Ads weiter.

- Du überwachst laufend die Performance unserer Kampagnen und leitest aus Daten konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.

- Du analysierst relevante KPIs entlang des Funnels und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, welche Zielgruppen, Botschaften, Creatives und Kampagnen funktionieren.

- Du setzt Kampagnen operativ auf, testest neue Ansätze und sorgst für eine saubere technische Umsetzung.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Growth zusammen und übersetzt die übergeordnete Growth-Strategie in wirkungsvolle Kampagnen.

- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserer Creative Agency neue Performance Creatives und Briefings und bringst deine Learnings aus den Plattformen direkt in die Creative-Entwicklung ein.

- Du beschäftigst dich nicht nur mit Conversion, sondern auch mit Upper-Funnel- und Demand-Generation-Maßnahmen, um neue Nachfrage für uns zu schaffen.

- Du beobachtest Plattformen, Trends und neue Formate und testest kontinuierlich, was für unsere Marke funktionieren könnte.

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Performance Marketing, Paid Social, Digital Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

- Gute praktische Erfahrung mit Google Ads – vom Kampagnen-Setup bis zur laufenden Optimierung und Analyse.

- Ein gutes Verständnis der wichtigsten Marketing-KPIs und die Fähigkeit, aus Zahlen konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

- Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du möchtest Kampagnen nicht nur diskutieren, sondern selbst im Account arbeiten, testen und optimieren.

- Analytisches Denken und Freude daran, herauszufinden, warum etwas funktioniert – oder eben nicht.

- Neugier und die Bereitschaft, Neues auszuprobieren und on the job dazuzulernen.

- Idealerweise Erfahrung mit einer Lifestyle- oder Consumer Brand, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen Food & Beverage, Beauty oder Fashion.

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, insbesondere mit Blick auf unseren Fokus auf den deutschen Markt.

- Erfahrung mit Upper-Funnel-Marketing bzw. Demand Generation ist ein Plus.

title: (Senior) Technischen Asset Manager(in) (m/w/d)
description:
Für ein renommiertes Unternehmen im Bereich der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Immobilienprojekten sucht SKILLs einen oder eine Technischen Asset Manager/in (m/w/d).

Unser Mandant ist strategischer Partner institutioneller Investoren. Als Teil einer inhabergeführten Gruppe verfügt das Unternehmen über umfassendes Immobilien- und Kapitalmarktwissen und folgt einem ganzheitlichen Dienstleistungsansatz, der sich über den gesamten Immobilienzyklus erstreckt. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt auf maßgeschneiderten Investment-Konzepten und dem aktiven Asset Management deutschlandweiter Immobilienbestände.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Technische Betreuung und Überwachung anspruchsvoller Immobilienprojekte

- Koordination des Gewährleistungsmanagements und Vertretung der Bauherreninteressen

- Verwaltung und technische Begleitung unserer Assets über den gesamten Lebenszyklus

- Durchführung technischer Bewertungen und Analysen zur Unterstützung strategischer Entscheidungen

Ihr Profil:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar – idealerweise mit Immobilienbezug

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bau- oder Immobilienumfeld

- Praxiserprobte Kenntnisse im technischen Asset Management, Bauherrenvertretung oder Gewährleistungsmanagement

- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und strukturierte Herangehensweise

- Kommunikationsstark, teamfähig und eigenverantwortlich

Das Angebot:

- Familiengeführtes mittelständisches Unternehmen

title: Marketing Project Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Project Management meets Hands-on Marketing & AI 

📍 München, Maxvorstadt | Hybrid | Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche)

💰 50.000–60.000 € brutto/Jahr , abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation

Ein neues Kundenprojekt kommt rein. Unterschiedliche Anforderungen, neue Herausforderungen, viele Möglichkeiten.

Während andere erst einmal überlegen, wer sich darum kümmern könnte, denkst du schon: „Spannend. Ich übernehme das. Let's go!“ 

Du verstehst, was der Kunde braucht, entwickelst passende Lösungen, kalkulierst ein Angebot und bringst das Projekt auf den Weg. Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten, packst selbst mit an und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee ein richtig gutes Ergebnis wird.

Dabei ist KI für dich nicht einfach ein nettes Extra. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, baust dir eigene Workflows und hast den Anspruch, dich in neue Tools schnell einzuarbeiten und sie wirklich auszureizen.

Ob Kampagne, Website oder Content: Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können. Aber du weißt, wie du die richtigen Menschen, Ideen und Technologien zusammenbringst.

Du bist nicht nur dabei. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst mit und machst Dinge möglich. 

Was du bei uns machst 

Du übernimmst abwechslungsreiche Marketingprojekte von A bis Z – von der ersten Anfrage bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

- Du übernimmst Ownership. Du machst Kundenprojekte zu deinen eigenen, führst sie eigenständig von Briefing und Konzeption bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass alles läuft.

- Du berätst und entwickelst Lösungen. Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Kunden, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst passende Konzepte und Maßnahmen.

- Du kalkulierst und planst. Du erstellst Angebote, schätzt Aufwände ein, planst Ressourcen und behältst Budgets, Timings und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick.

- Du packst selbst mit an. Ob Konzepte, Präsentationen, Texte, Briefings oder andere Marketing-Deliverables: Du setzt Aufgaben auch selbst um, statt ausschließlich zu delegieren.

- Du nutzt KI und entwickelst neue Workflows. Mit Tools wie ChatGPT und Claude optimierst du deine Arbeit, automatisierst Prozesse und probierst neue Wege aus, von denen auch das Team profitiert.

- Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten. Du steuerst interne Teams, Kreative, Entwickler und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für klare Briefings und gute Ergebnisse.

- Du bist Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden. Du führst Meetings, präsentierst Ergebnisse, steuerst Erwartungen und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit.

Dich erwartet ein bunter Mix aus Kunden, Branchen und Marketingdisziplinen. Langfristig kannst du je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen auch eigene Schwerpunkte entwickeln.

KI ist für uns kein Buzzword 

Wir gehören zu den Agenturen, die KI-Tools gezielt, geplant und mit echtem Mehrwert einsetzen – nicht als Experiment, sondern im Arbeitsalltag. Darauf sind wir stolz, und genau das bauen wir weiter aus.

Schon heute nutzen wir eigene KI-Workflows, zum Beispiel für Projektsteuerung, Konzepte, Umsetzung und interne Prozesse.

Du musst dafür kein Entwickler oder Automatisierungsexperte sein. Aber du solltest KI-Tools sicher beherrschen und Lust haben, unsere Workflows weiterzuentwickeln und neue zu bauen, von denen das ganze Team und unsere Kunden profitieren.

Dafür bekommst du bei uns die Tools, den Freiraum und die Zeit.

Was diese Stelle NICHT ist 

Kein reines Projektmanagement. Wenn du am liebsten ausschließlich Aufgaben verteilst, Timelines aktualisierst und Statusmeetings organisierst, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Du sollst Projekte auch inhaltlich voranbringen.

Keine reine Kundenberatung. Wir suchen niemanden, der Konzepte entwickelt und die Umsetzung dann vollständig an andere übergibt. Bei uns bleibst du dran, bis das Ergebnis steht.

Keine reine operative Marketingrolle. Du arbeitest nicht einfach nur Briefings ab, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für das große Ganze und steuerst die Umsetzung.

Keine Spezialistenrolle für nur eine Marketingdisziplin. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, solltest aber Lust auf unterschiedliche Marketingthemen und neue Herausforderungen haben.

Und definitiv keine Rolle, in der KI nur bedeutet, gelegentlich ChatGPT nach einem Text zu fragen. Wir suchen jemanden, der neue Möglichkeiten aktiv erkundet und eigene Ideen entwickelt.

Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen keinen reinen Verwalter, Berater oder Umsetzer. Sondern jemanden, der all das sinnvoll miteinander verbindet. 

Was du mitbringst 

- Du hast idealerweise 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing , vorzugsweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast bereits eigenständig Kundenprojekte betreut.

- Du bringst ein breites Marketingverständnis mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Themen, Branchen und Aufgabenstellungen einarbeiten.

- Du hast Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Aufwandsschätzung und Budgetsteuerung und verstehst die wirtschaftliche Seite von Projekten.

- Du bist organisatorisch, konzeptionell und operativ stark, kommunizierst souverän mit Kunden und kannst Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen.

- KI ist fester Teil deiner Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, hast bereits eigene KI-Workflows aufgebaut oder Arbeitsabläufe damit spürbar verbessert und kannst uns konkret zeigen, wie.

- Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch, findest Lösungen statt Probleme weiterzugeben und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

- Du hast Spaß an Abwechslung, denkst über deinen eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus und möchtest dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln.

Was uns wichtiger ist als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marketing, denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge zuverlässig ins Ziel. Und du hast richtig Lust darauf, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie modernes Marketing mit KI noch besser funktionieren kann.

Warum Effecticore? 

Weil gute Arbeit Spaß machen darf. Und das Leben neben der Arbeit genauso wichtig ist. 

Wir verbringen einen großen Teil unserer Zeit miteinander. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass wir nicht nur gut zusammenarbeiten, sondern auch menschlich auf einer Wellenlänge sind. Wir mögen unkomplizierte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitige Unterstützung und eine ordentliche Portion Humor.

Was dich bei uns erwartet: 

- Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird. Zwei bis drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind bei uns ganz normal. Wann du sie nutzt, stimmen wir flexibel miteinander ab. Auch private Termine zwischendurch oder kurzfristiger Urlaub sind kein Problem. Unsere üblichen Arbeitszeiten liegen ungefähr zwischen 9 und 18 Uhr – mit genügend Spielraum für das echte Leben.

- Verantwortung und Freiraum. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, kannst eigene Entscheidungen treffen und Projekte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.

- Raum für KI und neue Ideen. Du bekommst Zugang zu professionellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, damit zu experimentieren, neue Workflows zu entwickeln und Prozesse zu optimieren – ausdrücklich während deiner Arbeitszeit.

- Ein Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und lachen viel. Freiwillige Teamabende und gemeinsame Aktionen gehören auch dazu.

- Workation in Kroatien. Einmal im Jahr tauschen wir unser Büro gegen eine Villa in Kroatien und verbringen dort eine gemeinsame Woche mit Arbeiten, Sonne und Teamzeit.

- Weiterentwicklung, die zu dir passt. Wir unterstützen individuelle Fortbildungen und geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen und neue Themen für dich zu entdecken.

- Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen. Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige Ausstattung, gute Erreichbarkeit, kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks. Und auch Hunde sind bei uns willkommen.

- Wellpass für deine Gesundheit. Ob Gym, Yoga, Schwimmen oder Wellness – mit Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, auch außerhalb der Arbeit etwas für dich zu tun.

Und vielleicht das Wichtigste: Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst, aber nicht wichtiger als alles andere. 

Natürlich wollen wir für unsere Kunden richtig gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind Dienstleister, wir übernehmen Verantwortung und manchmal muss auch etwas kurzfristig möglich gemacht werden.

Aber wir glauben nicht daran, dass gute Kundenarbeit bedeutet, ständig erreichbar zu sein, regelmäßig Überstunden zu machen oder das eigene Privatleben hintenanzustellen.

Wir wollen gemeinsam erfolgreich sein, gute Arbeit leisten und dabei auch noch Spaß haben.

Denn am Ende sollen nicht nur unsere Kunden gerne mit uns arbeiten. Sondern wir auch gerne miteinander. 

Klingt nach dir? 

Du hast beim Lesen schon überlegt, welche Projekte du bei uns übernehmen und welche Prozesse du mit KI verbessern könntest?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, zu erfahren, welche Projekte du bisher umgesetzt hast und welche Ideen du mitbringst.

- LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team: 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Reconciliation and Financial Reporting at BVNK.

Your mission is to make sure every movement of money across the BVNK platform, in fiat and in stablecoins, is accounted for, matched and reported correctly. You'll own our internal financial reporting engine and reconciliation platform, and make sure every product we build, including the products we're building with Mastercard, goes live with the right reconciliation and reporting in place.

This is an operations and data-heavy product. You'll work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to understand where breaks and manual work come from, and turn that into a prioritised backlog. You'll also partner with finance, treasury and compliance, who rely on accurate reconciliation for safeguarding, month-end close and regulatory reporting.

You'll work with engineers across the payments, wallets and ledger teams on the data structures and events that reconciliation depends on, and with small, autonomous engineering squads across BVNK. We see AI as a key lever in how we build, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities: 

- Own the reconciliation and reporting strategy and roadmap, from how transaction data is captured at source to the reports that finance, operations and regulators rely on.

- Own BVNK's internal financial reporting engine, including balance, transaction, fee and safeguarding reporting, and make sure it is accurate, timely and auditable.

- Make sure every new product, currency, payment rail, banking partner and blockchain network is backed by the correct reconciliation and reporting before it launches. Build reconciliation requirements into launch readiness, and work with other PMs so they are planned from the start rather than added afterwards.

- Work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to find the root causes of breaks, exceptions and manual workarounds, and build the backlog accordingly.

- Work with engineers on the payments, wallets and events data structures, so that every transaction carries the identifiers, statuses and metadata needed to match it automatically across internal ledgers, bank and PSP statements, and on-chain activity.

- Improve the matching engine and exception tooling, including matching rules, break ageing and investigation workflows, and audit trails.

- Own how external data comes into the platform, such as bank statements (for example camt.053 and MT940), PSP and liquidity provider reports, and blockchain data, along with the data quality controls around it.

- Partner with finance, treasury, compliance and audit on safeguarding reconciliation, month-end close, and regulatory and audit reporting.

- Take part in resolving reconciliation and regulatory incidents, including safeguarding incidents. When issues arise, respond quickly, work with Operations, Engineering, Finance and Compliance to find the cause and fix it, and follow up with product changes that stop it happening again.

- Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and see work through to release.

- Define and track the measures that matter, such as auto-match rate, number and age of open breaks, time to resolve, reporting timeliness and manual effort. Use data to decide what to build next.

What we need from you: 

- Several years of product management experience in payments, banking or fintech, ideally owning reconciliation, ledger, finance or reporting products.

- Solid technical knowledge. You're comfortable working with engineers on data models, ledgers, event-driven systems, APIs and data pipelines, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code. You're happy to query data yourself using SQL.

- A good understanding of reconciliation and financial reporting: double-entry accounting, transaction lifecycles, settlement, matching logic and why breaks happen.

- Experience in operations, or working closely with operations teams. You understand how exceptions and manual processes are handled day to day, and you build products that reduce them. When something goes wrong, you respond quickly and stay calm under pressure.

- Experience in the payments and/or banking industry, for example with payment schemes such as SEPA, ACH, Faster Payments or SWIFT, bank statement formats, or settlement with banks and PSPs.

- Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders and explain complex topics simply to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- The ability to build and articulate plans, and to align and communicate on them with other PMs and stakeholders. You manage dependencies across teams, handle competing priorities and can say no with a clear rationale.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You create structure where requirements are still evolving and keep complex work moving.

- An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, not just to summarise.

Bonus if you have: 

- Experience with stablecoins, blockchain networks or crypto operations, including on-chain reconciliation of wallets.

- Experience building or replacing a reconciliation platform, either in-house or with a vendor.

- Experience with safeguarding or regulatory reporting for e-money or payment institutions.

- Experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions.

What you can expect from us: 

- Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth

- Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart

- A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people

- A flexible approach to holiday 

- Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world 

- An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

description:

The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary 

We're looking for a forward-thinking Security Engineer to join our security team, focused on offensive and defensive testing, penetration testing of product features, and the cloud architecture behind the product. You'll operate across a complex multi-cloud environment (AWS & GCP) spanning traditional VMs and modern managed and unmanaged container-based architectures, partnering with fellow Penetration Testing and Cloud Security engineers to run targeted assessments during the testing window immediately before each release. The role reaches beyond the application layer into the Control Plane, reviewing cloud configurations, IAM policies, and orchestration layers against security baselines, and extends to the frontline of external defense by triaging bug bounty submissions and outside vulnerability reports. AI and large language models are core to how this team works day to day — you'll use them to accelerate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, while applying human judgment to validate findings and communicate risk clearly to product teams. Speed matters here: the team's operating cadence is built around identifying, validating, and reporting vulnerabilities quickly enough to keep pace with release velocity.

Outcomes & KPIs 

Key Outcome(s) Owned: 

- Ensure new product features and the underlying multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) infrastructure are rigorously security-tested before release, and that vulnerabilities surfaced internally or via bug bounty are triaged and communicated with speed and precision.

Success Metrics / KPIs :

- Percentage of roadmap features assessed within the pre-release testing window.

- Mean time to triage and validate bug bounty / external vulnerability reports.

- Reduction in critical/high-severity vulnerabilities escaping to production post-release.

- Time saved per assessment cycle through AI-assisted tooling and automation.

- Quality and actionability of vulnerability reports and PoCs, as rated by product teams.

What You'll Do 

- Conduct deep-dive penetration tests of products across a multi-cloud (AWS & GCP) environment, working in tandem with a peer pentester.

- Review IAM policies, service configurations, and cloud-native permission structures across the Control Plane to ensure cloud configurations meet security baselines.

- Execute dynamic testing against web interfaces and API endpoints (Data Plane & Web UI).

- Assess the security posture of hybrid infrastructure spanning containers and virtual machines.

- Triage findings, build clear and reproducible proofs-of-concept, and partner with product teams to explain risk and drive remediation.

- Use AI and large language models to automate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, applying strong prompt-engineering skills to security contexts.

- Monitor bug bounty pipelines and external reports, validating findings and managing researcher communication.

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE 
We’re looking for a Firmware Engineer to join our small team developing high-reliability firmware for some of the most challenging environments on earth. Working on 32-bit Arm Cortex-M processors, you’ll own firmware architecture, development, testing and debugging across ARD’s products, from low-level drivers through to networking and application logic, and work closely with our hardware engineers from bring-up to field deployment. We want you to use your experience to make key technical decisions, challenge the team constructively, and balance delivery against long-term quality, so that our products are dependable enough for the Arctic.

- Testing & Debugging — Test and validate firmware at unit, integration and system level, diagnosing issues on real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and debug probes.

- RTOS & Boot Systems — Develop RTOS-based and interrupt-driven firmware, along with bootloaders and OTA update mechanisms, to meet strict timing and reliability requirements.

- Code Quality & Version Control — Maintain high code quality through peer review, coding standards and Git-based release management.

- Team & Collaboration — Pick up, improve and extend existing designs as readily as building new ones, working alongside software, mechanical and QA colleagues on documentation, design reviews and compliance testing.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C for Arm or equivalent processors.

- Willingness to adopt and embrace an AI-accelerated development workflow.

- Experience across the full software development life cycle: writing and gathering requirements, design documentation, design and code review, writing test plans and testing.

- Experience with low-level comms interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART).

- Experienced Git user.

- Experience with RTOS and bare-metal design.

- Understanding of bootloaders and OTA for updating multi-processor products.

- Experience debugging on real hardware and confidence using basic equipment such as logic analysers and oscilloscopes.

- Willingness to test in the field to prove functionality and compliance.

- A self-driven attitude and the confidence to be the subject matter expert in a startup, combined with a collaborative approach and a willingness to build on others’ work.

Desirable 

- Experience with STM32 and Nordic nRF platforms.

- Understanding of electronics design, such as reading schematics, and soldering.

- TCP/IP and networking experience.

- Embedded security experience, such as secure boot, signed or encrypted firmware updates, and awareness of regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

- Experience with CI systems.

- Experience in both regulated environments and R&D or rapid-prototyping environments.

- A degree in a related engineering discipline such as software or electronics, though experience is valued more highly.

Future Security Clearance Requirements

Why ARD

title: Account Executive - Enterprise
description:
Account Executive - Enterprise 

Edinburgh

Wordsmith 

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role 

We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations.

You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams.

You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome.

What you’ll do 

- Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities

- Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups

- Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

- Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

- Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum

- Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers on solution design

- Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility

What we’re looking for 

- Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

- Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

- Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions

- Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

- Structured, strategic approach to deal management

- High ownership and accountability for outcomes

How we work 

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office or out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

Why Wordsmith 

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

title: Copy Editor
description:
About Legal 500 

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

Freelance Copy Editor

Remote | £5.20 per editorial | Contract until February 2027 

About the opportunity

We’re looking for experienced freelance Copy Editors to support our EMEA research and editorial team during a busy part of our publication cycle.

You’ll review and refine written assessments produced by our researchers, helping to ensure that our editorial content is accurate, consistent and easy to read. This is a fully remote freelance opportunity, suited to someone who is comfortable working independently, managing a high volume of content and delivering work to fixed deadlines.

What you’ll be doing

- Reviewing researchers’ written assessments of law firm practices to ensure they are clear, accurate and logically structured.

- Making light edits to address significant grammar, clarity or house-style issues.

- Proofreading matter summaries and key client lists submitted by law firms.

- Checking that firm-submitted content follows our editorial standards and house style.

- Cross-checking lawyer information to ensure ranked individuals are included in the relevant editorial commentary and key lawyer lists.

- Confirming that every ranked firm that submitted information has a completed editorial commentary.

- Checking that researchers have provided submission scores for all ranked and unranked submissions.

- Giving researchers clear and constructive feedback to help improve the quality of their work.

- Raising questions, inconsistencies or missing information promptly so these can be resolved before publication. 

What we’re looking for

- Previous experience in copy editing, proofreading, editorial production or a similar role.

- Excellent written English, with strong grammar, spelling and punctuation skills.

- A sharp eye for detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies or missing information.

- The confidence to make sensible editorial decisions while preserving the original meaning and tone.

- The ability to process a high volume of content accurately within a fixed publication schedule.

- Experience working with legal, professional-services or research-led content, although this would be helpful rather than essential.

Assignment details

- Contract type: Freelance (Umbrella / Ltd Company or Self-employed)

- Location: UK based only - Fully remote; need to be eligible to work in the UK 

- Contract start date: 30th Nov 2026

- Contract end date: Feb 2027

- Rate: £5.20 per completed editorial(50 editorials per day expectation)

As this is a freelance assignment, earnings will depend on the number of editorials completed and accepted. The £260 figure is an average rather than a guaranteed daily rate.

title: Head of Workplace Engineering
description:
Join our expanding Workplace Engineering team! We’re recruiting a Head of Workplace Engineering to run IT at M-KOPA as a product, with automation first, so 2,500+ colleagues can keep serving Africa’s Every Day Earners. 

**Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role** 

The Impact 

Your engineering will keep a pan-African fintech running across five offices, four warehouses, 100+ retail sites and 10 call centres in six countries. We’ve now served 10 million customers, unlocked $2+ billion in credit and created income for 35,000+ agents. It’s your chance to be part of something that’s transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity 

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every device provisioned, access request automated and call-centre line kept up helps the people serving our customers.

🏆 Global recognition: Named by TIME 100 as one of the world’s most influential companies, and by the Financial Times as one of Africa’s fastest-growing for four consecutive years (2022-2025).

🚀 Scale challenges: Run IT across six countries, from call-centre agents to the executive team, using repeatable, templated builds for new sites and markets.

🌱 Environmental impact: We’re carbon-negative, with over 2 million tonnes of emissions avoided.

What You’ll Do 

You’ll lead our IT function, including the Helpdesk and IT Infrastructure teams, and be accountable for the cost, security, reliability and user experience of our internal estate. We’re not hiring a traditional IT manager. We want an engineer who would rather write the automation than raise the ticket.

- Own the IT roadmap and budget, treating internal services as products with clear users and measured adoption

- Run the corporate Azure and Microsoft estate as code, deployed through CI/CD

- Automate joiner/mover/leaver, device provisioning, licensing and access requests, driven from the HR system of record

- Own identity, end-user devices, networks across all our sites, and contact-centre telephony across ~10 call centres

- Move support from reactive tickets to self-service and automated resolution, using AI and agentic tooling where it genuinely removes work

- Own IT security hygiene, business continuity and compliance, with audit evidence generated from systems

Your Environment 💻

- Microsoft and cloud: Azure, Entra ID, Intune, M365

- Infrastructure as code: Bicep and/or Terraform, Git, pull requests, CI/CD

- Scripting: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript or similar

- Integrations: APIs and workflow tooling across HR, identity, ITSM and finance systems

This role covers internal IT. The infrastructure behind our customer-facing products sits with Engineering. 

Our Approach 🚀

- Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

- Data over anecdote

- A team that builds rather than firefights

- Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

What You Need 

You also need to be good with people. Our users range from call-centre agents to the executive team, and you should be the person they want to talk to when something is broken.

- A strong engineering background: you write code regularly and are comfortable with Git, pull requests and CI/CD

- Deep Azure and Microsoft experience: Entra ID, Intune, M365, Azure networking and core services

- Hands-on infrastructure as code with Bicep and/or Terraform in production

- A track record of automating IT operations at scale, with the before and after to show for it

- Experience leading teams, including non-engineering teams such as a service desk

- Approachable: you explain technical trade-offs in plain language and build trust at every level

Nice to have: multi-country IT experience (ideally in high-growth or emerging markets); networking fundamentals (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, ISPs) and contact-centre telephony; vendor management; applying LLMs or agentic workflows to internal operations; relevant certifications. We care more about what you’ve built than where you learnt it.

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

Location & Benefits 

- Based in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Uganda, the UK or the EU, with significant travel of up to 25% at times, especially early in the role

- Benefits package, which includes Bonus & Growth Shares

- Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe and Africa

- Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

- Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

- Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

- Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

- Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product to generate income, and 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

- Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided, with over 127,000 circular economy products provided

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering? Apply now! 

Why M-KOPA?

Title : Director, EMEA Insights 

Status : Hybrid 

Department : Global Insights 

Location : UK Office 

Reporting Relationship : VP, Global Insights 

Position Summary 

e.l.f. Beauty is looking for a Director, EMEA Insights to join our dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth company. The ideal candidate will have a consumer and community-first mindset with a strong background in executing consumer research and synthesizing market data to analyze and articulate consumer trends and business impacts. This person is highly self-motivated, inherently curious, and strategic yet detail-oriented, with a passion for analyzing data, surfacing insights, and storytelling with data to drive business decisions. 

The position will report directly to the Vice President, Global Insights. 

The Director, EMEA Insights is responsible for overseeing the EMEA-focused market and consumer insights functions, including market analysis, competitive intelligence, product insights, consumer research, audience segmentation, trends, and foresight, to drive actionable, data-driven growth through compelling storytelling. This individual will be adept at connecting dots across multiple data sources and strategically distilling and disseminating those actionable insights to all levels in the organization. This individual will be a thought leader and work collaboratively with cross-functional partners, acting as the voice of the EMEA consumer in making strategic connections between broad-based trends and marketplace opportunities. The ideal candidate is data-driven, results-oriented, has excellent communication skills, and is comfortable operating across all levels of the business, from strategic to tactical. 

This position is based in e.l.f.’s London office with a hybrid 3-day in office schedule. 

Responsibilities : 

- Strategically distill insights from diverse data sources and present them to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a compelling narrative with concise and actionable findings and implications. 

- Leverage multiple data sources to connect dots and develop a comprehensive understanding of the business environment including brand performance, competitive brands and products, social dynamics, consumer behavior, demographic/audience factors, and macroeconomics, keeping a pulse on consistently evolving trends and foresight within and beyond beauty. Disseminate insights and strategic recommendations throughout the organization at all levels. 

- Leverage syndicated data tracking resources (e.g. NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, WGSN, Shopper Insights, Mintel, Spate, GfK) for frequent analysis of trends and identifying whitespace opportunities. 

- Lead the evolving EMEA consumer profile and audience segmentation initiatives across the brand portfolio. 

- Analyze social media conversations and trends, translating to actionable recommendations for marketing teams. 

- Own end-to-end creation of Insights presentations (e.g., PowerPoint), i.e., from storyline through final edits. 

- Collaborate with stakeholders in brand, innovation, digital, creative, sales, and Integrated Marketing Communications functions, surfacing insights and analytics to further promote and enable consumer-centric, data-driven decision-making in EMEA markets. 

- Develop and maintain relationships with external data and research partners (NielsenIQ, Circana, Mintel, YouGov, etc.), while consistently evaluating potential new data and research partners. 

- Drive the exploration and implementation of innovative research, trend tracking and social listening methodologies, including AI, to create next generation insights approaches and methodologies. 

- Partner with US-based Global Insights team to connect dots and unify insights that drive the business. 

Requirements : 

- Minimum 10+ years of experience in consumer research, market analysis, and data insights and analytics, inclusive of experience leading a multi-disciplinary consumer and market insights team. 

- Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field. A master's degree or MBA is a plus. 

- Strong ability to analyze and synthesize disparate information from multiple data sources into a holistic story with strategic implications and recommendations. Capable of turning complex information into simple and understandable messaging. 

- Adept at designing and executing multi-country end-to-end quantitative and qualitative consumer research (i.e., survey development, discussion moderation), with the ability to generate relevant and actionable insights connected to consumer needs and business strategies. 

- Experience with multiple types of custom research, including positioning, segmentation, innovation concepts, advertising/concept testing, consumer journeys, path to purchase, brand health tracking, etc. 

- Outstanding ability to navigate syndicated data sets (e.g., NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, GfK, Shopper Insights) beyond pulling numbers, to analyze and distill the most relevant insights. 

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to work independently and effectively across multiple projects, without sacrificing accuracy and attention to detail, in an extremely fast-paced environment. 

- Inherently curious, proactive, and enjoys digging beyond the surface to uncover insights. Exceptional at finding trends and the story in the data, articulating the “so what,” and translating insights into strategic, actionable recommendations. 

- Passionate about customer-centricity and data-driven strategy, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders. 

- Outstanding analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills with extreme attention to detail. Ability to focus on both strategy and execution. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication and data story-telling skills, including the ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders. Has executive presence with a high degree of comfort working with and presenting to senior leaders. 

- Adept at utilizing AI tools for efficiency and enhanced deliverables. 

- Thrives in ambiguity, with strong prioritization and project management skills. 

- Localized knowledge of EMEA regions to surface local trends and execute relevant research. 

- Proficient in MS Office core suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) 

- Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.). 

- Experience using data analytics tools and languages such as SQL, SPSS, etc. 

- Consumer goods industry experience preferred. 

- Passionate about the beauty industry.

title: Strategic Account Director
description:
About Valiantys 

Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. Valiantys unlocks the full value of Atlassian’s System of Work, helping customers revolutionize product development, streamline enterprise service management (ESM), and accelerate cloud transformation. Federal and highly regulated organizations trust Valiantys to help them maximize the potential of Atlassian solutions and reach their goals. More information about Valiantys is available at www.valiantys.com .

Job summary

Valiantys is looking for a Strategic Account Director to accelerate growth across our most important enterprise clients and prospects.

This role is a senior, services-led growth position for a commercially ambitious leader who can create opportunity at executive level, shape complex transformation agendas and convert them into significant consulting, professional services and long-term managed services relationships.

You will operate at the intersection of client strategy, technology transformation and commercial growth, building trusted relationships with senior executives, identifying where Valiantys can create meaningful business impact and mobilizing the right expertise from across our organization to make it happen.

Your mandate is clear: open doors, create demand, expand strategic relationships and build substantial, sustainable services revenue.

Your impact

Strategic Accounts

For senior sales professionals who are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating complex organizations and expanding strategic customer relationships over time.

You will build trusted executive relationships, identify transformation priorities, create long-term account strategies and grow the value Valiantys delivers across a customer organization. 

What you will do

Strategic account leadership

- 
You will think like the CEO of your accounts.

That means understanding each client’s strategy, organization, technology landscape, investment priorities, stakeholders and competitive dynamics and translating that intelligence into a deliberate growth strategy.

You will build and execute account plans that answer three fundamental questions:

- 
Where can Valiantys create the greatest value?

- 
Who do we need to influence to make that happen?

- 
How do we turn that value into sustainable commercial growth?

You will develop relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, create executive sponsorship, uncover new buying centers and build a strong pipeline of opportunities capable of materially growing each account.

Selling outcomes, not capacity

- 
The strongest candidates will understand that sophisticated services sales is not about selling consultants, days or technical resources. It is about selling change and business outcomes.

You will lead discovery around the client’s most important challenges and ambitions, working with Valiantys’ consulting and technical experts to turn those conversations into propositions that have clear strategic relevance and measurable value.

Whether the opportunity involves enterprise transformation, ITSM/ESM, cloud, DevOps, platform strategy, AI, operating-model change or managed services, you will ensure the conversation begins with the client’s desired outcome, not the technology.

Orchestrating Valiantys

- 
Complex services opportunities are won as a team.

You will act as the commercial orchestrator for your accounts, bringing together the best of Valiantys across consulting, solution architecture, delivery, customer success, managed services and executive leadership.

You will create clarity around the client’s ambition, establish a compelling win strategy and ensure our teams are aligned around the outcome we are trying to achieve.

You will also work closely with Atlassian and our broader partner ecosystem, building strong field relationships and turning platform opportunities into larger transformation and services engagements.

Your objective is not simply to participate in opportunities. It is to shape them.

Bring commercial discipline

- 
Maintain accurate forecasting, qualification and opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.

- 
Apply MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to create clarity, momentum and accountability.

- 
Contribute to strategic account planning, regional strategy and commercial reporting.

- 
Monitor portfolio performance and adjust priorities based on data, market signals and customer engagement.

- 
Share insight, best practices and relevant market intelligence with the wider sales organization.

What you need to be successful

We are looking for an enterprise seller with a strong record of building and closing significant consulting and professional services business with more than 10 years of experience minimum. 

You will bring most of the following:

- 
A proven track record of winning complex, high-value professional services, consulting or transformation engagements within enterprise organizations.

- 
Evidence of consistently delivering against ambitious services revenue and bookings targets.

- 
Strong experience growing strategic accounts and creating substantial new revenue within existing client relationships.

- 
The ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, combining commercial confidence with intellectual curiosity.

- 
The ability to move comfortably between strategic business conversations and the commercial detail required to get complex deals signed.

- 
Experience creating opportunities where no formal requirement or RFP previously existed.

- 
Strong commercial judgment across pricing, scope, margin, contracting, negotiation and deal structure.

- 
The ability to navigate complex organizations, political environments and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

- 
Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams around large pursuits.

- 
Strong forecasting, pipeline management and opportunity qualification discipline.

- 
Experience within technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise service management, ITSM, cloud, DevOps, AI transformation or the Atlassian ecosystem would be highly valuable.

- 
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to align consultants, delivery teams, partners and executives around a shared opportunity.

- Fluent in English and in French

If you are ready to develop strategic accounts, achieve ambitious goals, and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

Why Valiantys?

Valiantys is a fast-growing, international and entrepreneurial organization at the intersection of technology, consulting and business transformation. You will work with experienced specialists who care about the quality of the outcome—not just the signature of the contract.

What we offer

An international, multicultural team and a genuinely European scope.

- 
A flexible telework program.

Choice of PC or Mac.

Training time and budget to support your development.

title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
description:
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 

Thiga en 30 secondes : 

Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris.
Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours

Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.

Ce que tu vas faire 🖇 

1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events 

- 
Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription

- 
Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas

- 
Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée

- 
Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA

- 
Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com

- 
Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister

- 
Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence

2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer 

Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

- 
Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions

- 
Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne

- 
Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater

- 
Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel 

L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.

- 
Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA

- 
Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous , c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.

La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰 

Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.

- 
LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini

-

title: SMB Account Executive | France | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

The Opportunity 

Grafana Labs is looking for an SMB Account Executive who will be responsible for prospecting and growing existing business across their assigned region. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with existing customers. You will manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking about our products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products.

- Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers

- Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals

- Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)

- Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

- Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise

- Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

- Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

- 1+ years of experience in software sales with a proven track record of exceeding targets in a competitive environment

- Results driven mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, drive deals forward, and deliver measurable results

- Excellent communication skills across all channels (in person, online, in writing) with the ability to build strong working relationships both in person and virtually

- Strong interest in observability and technical sales 

- Self-starter mentality, thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments where innovation and execution matter

- Experience with Salesforce, Gong, Quoting tools, and Zoominfo is preferred

- Familiarity with Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC sales methodologies is ideal

In France, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 87,000 - EUR 94,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

title: Head of Customer Experience & Trust
description:

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

We're looking for a Head of Customer Experience & Trust to be the guardian of the tenant experience on our unified platform. As we consolidate the HousingAnywhere and Studapart operations teams, you will lead a multi-site support and trust organisation across Rotterdam and Cergy and own not just how we respond to our users, but the content, policies, and safeguards that shape their experience before they ever contact us.

Your role and impact

- Lead the shift to AI-first support: Make our AI agent the first point of resolution for tenants and landlords, across all channels. Report on automated resolution, quality and CSAT as seriously as on human SLAs, and prioritise support needs in the Ops automation roadmap.

- Set the direction for our AI agent: Decide what the AI agent should resolve, what it must never do, and when it hands over to a human. Set its resolution and quality targets, and approve how our policies are explained. Work with the Ops Project Manager, who owns the knowledge base and runs the AI agent day to day.

- Redesign the team around AI: Lead the CS Team Managers in Cergy and Rotterdam and, through them, a team of experts with local market knowledge. Evolve roles so agents spend their time on complex, sensitive and high-value cases, and on training and supervising the AI. Build one standard way of working across both sites.

- Own the rules: Own T&Cs and service policies with Legal, and approve how they are explained to users. The Ops Project Manager turns them into help content for users, our AI agent and our teams.

Select, onboard and manage BPO partners to absorb peak volumes, with clear quality standards, SLAs and costs. Work with the Quality & Training Manager to train BPO agents and monitor their quality, and with the Ops Project Manager to give them the knowledge base and tools they need.

- Raise the quality bar: Use the Voice of Customer insights and AI-assisted quality reviews led by the Quality & Training Manager to drive change in your teams and raise quality of service and all departments.

This covers listing moderation, fraud prevention and dispute handling. - Peak and partner management: You have prepared support teams for seasonal peaks, and have selected and managed BPO partners, holding them to the same quality standard as your own team.

description:

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
The role 

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities 

Build and ship 

- Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production

- Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation

- Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call

- Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction 

- Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured

- Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit

- Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design 

- Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity

- Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin

- Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works 

- Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working 

- Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes

- Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise 

AI-native engineering 

- Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace

- Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows

- Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release

- Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails

- Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders

- Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations 

- Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating

- Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)

- Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores

- Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry

- Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building 

- Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop

- Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills 

- Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements

- Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets

- Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value

- Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer

- Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person

- Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated

Our Offer

Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

- 
Flexi-office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.

Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.

Health and Wellbeing : With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.

Development : We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.

Appreciation : Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
